recitationTipsZh: 原典古汉语音译：「曩莫薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩怛吠毗藥 曩謨婆誐嚩帝烏瑟抳沙耶 曩謨阿彌多婆耶怛他孽多夜囉訶帝三藐三沒馱耶 曩謨婆誐嚩帝尾囉嚩日囉馱囉耶娑誐囉捏具曬耶怛他孽多耶 ｜ 曩莫三曼多沒馱喃 唵悉怛多鉢怛囉烏瑟抳沙阿波囉爾帝缽囉底揚擬囉耶 薩嚩部多孽囉訶尼孽囉訶羯囉抳 波囉尾你也叱陀你 阿迦囉蜜哩底瑜鉢哩怛囉拏羯哩 ｜ 薩嚩滿馱曩目叉抳 薩嚩耨瑟吒耨娑嚩跛曩你嚩囉抳 左睹囉始底喃孽囉訶娑訶薩囉喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩 阿瑟吒尾舍底喃曩乞察怛囉喃鉢囉娑娜曩羯哩 ｜ 阿瑟吒喃摩訶孽囉訶喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩 薩嚩設咄嚧你嚩囉抳 具囉耨娑嚩跛曩喃左曩舍抳 尾沙設娑怛囉阿祇尼烏怛囉抳 ｜ 阿波囉爾多摩訶具囉摩訶婆囉摩訶戰拏摩訶你跛多摩訶帝惹摩訶濕吠多摩訶入嚩攞摩訶半拏囉嚩悉抳 阿哩耶多囉勃哩俱胝誓嚩尾惹耶嚩日囉摩禮底尾戍嚕多 ｜ 鉢訥摩迦嚩日囉爾訶嚩左摩攞誓嚩阿波囉爾多 嚩日囉難尾舍攞左扇多吠提訶布爾多 蘇彌耶嚕波摩訶濕吠多阿哩耶多囉摩訶婆囉 阿波囉嚩日囉商攞誓嚩嚩日囉俱摩哩俱藍馱哩 ｜ 嚩日囉訶娑多左摩訶尾你也建左曩摩迦 俱蘇婆囉怛曩誓嚩吠嚧左曩俱攞他娜烏瑟抳沙尾日哩婆摩拏左薩嚩日囉迦曩迦鉢囉婆路左曩 嚩日囉頓左濕吠多左迦摩攞乞叉舍尸鉢囉婆 ｜ 伊帝帝母捺囉誐拏薩吠囉乞叉俱嚩睹摩摩薩嚩薩怛嚩喃左 唵哩瑟誐拏鉢囉舍娑多耶薩嚩怛他孽都瑟抳沙悉怛多鉢怛囉吽咄嚕唵 染婆曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 娑擔婆曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 謨訶曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 摩訶尾你也三婆叉拏羯哩吽咄嚕唵 ｜ 波囉尾你也三婆叉拏羯哩吽咄嚕唵 薩嚩耨瑟吒喃娑擔婆曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 薩嚩藥叉囉乞叉娑孽囉訶喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 左睹囉始底喃孽囉訶娑訶薩囉喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 ｜ 囉乞叉囉乞叉𤚥 婆誐鑁怛他孽都瑟抳沙悉怛多鉢怛囉摩訶嚩日嚧瑟抳沙摩訶鉢囉底揚擬囉摩訶娑訶薩囉部娑訶薩囉尸哩曬俱胝百千眼 阿陛你也入嚩多摩訶嚩日嚧娜囉底哩部嚩曩曼拏攞 唵娑嚩底婆嚩睹摩摩 ｜ 曳計質薩怛嚩摩摩阿呬帝史拏播跛質多嚕捺囉質多尾捺吠沙質多 尾你也嗔陀夜彌阿悉曩 枳攞夜彌嚩日囉拏 鉢哩嚩囉惹迦多尾你也嗔陀夜彌阿悉曩枳攞夜彌嚩日囉拏 荼吉尼多尾你也嗔陀夜彌阿悉曩枳攞夜彌嚩日囉拏 ｜ 叱陀你阿迦囉蜜哩柱般哩怛囉耶儜揭哩 怛你也他 唵阿那隸阿那隸尾舍提尾舍提鞞囉嚩日囉馱哩盤陀盤陀你嚩日囉謗尼泮 虎𤙖都嚧甕泮 娑嚩訶 唵薩嚩怛他孽都瑟抳沙悉怛多鉢怛囉吽泮吒吽媽媽吽抳娑嚩訶」。上方已还原其悉昙梵字、天城梵文、现代梵音拼读与唐代行琳法师夹注音法。

provenance.rawSnippet: 曩莫薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩怛吠毗藥 曩謨婆誐嚩帝烏瑟抳沙耶 曩謨阿彌多婆耶怛他孽多夜囉訶帝三藐三沒馱耶 曩謨婆誐嚩帝尾囉嚩日囉馱囉耶娑誐囉捏具曬耶怛他孽多耶 ｜ 曩莫三曼多沒馱喃 唵悉怛多鉢怛囉烏瑟抳沙阿波囉爾帝缽囉底揚擬囉耶 薩嚩部多孽囉訶尼孽囉訶羯囉抳 波囉尾你也叱陀你 阿迦囉蜜哩底瑜鉢哩怛囉拏羯哩 ｜ 薩嚩滿馱曩目叉抳 薩嚩耨瑟吒耨娑嚩跛曩你嚩囉抳 左睹囉始底喃孽囉訶娑訶薩囉喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩 阿瑟吒尾舍底喃曩乞察怛囉喃鉢囉娑娜曩羯哩 ｜ 阿瑟吒喃摩訶孽囉訶喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩 薩嚩設咄嚧你嚩囉抳 具囉耨娑嚩跛曩喃左曩舍抳 尾沙設娑怛囉阿祇尼烏怛囉抳 ｜ 阿波囉爾多摩訶具囉摩訶婆囉摩訶戰拏摩訶你跛多摩訶帝惹摩訶濕吠多摩訶入嚩攞摩訶半拏囉嚩悉抳 阿哩耶多囉勃哩俱胝誓嚩尾惹耶嚩日囉摩禮底尾戍嚕多 ｜ 鉢訥摩迦嚩日囉爾訶嚩左摩攞誓嚩阿波囉爾多 嚩日囉難尾舍攞左扇多吠提訶布爾多 蘇彌耶嚕波摩訶濕吠多阿哩耶多囉摩訶婆囉 阿波囉嚩日囉商攞誓嚩嚩日囉俱摩哩俱藍馱哩 ｜ 嚩日囉訶娑多左摩訶尾你也建左曩摩迦 俱蘇婆囉怛曩誓嚩吠嚧左曩俱攞他娜烏瑟抳沙尾日哩婆摩拏左薩嚩日囉迦曩迦鉢囉婆路左曩 嚩日囉頓左濕吠多左迦摩攞乞叉舍尸鉢囉婆 ｜ 伊帝帝母捺囉誐拏薩吠囉乞叉俱嚩睹摩摩薩嚩薩怛嚩喃左 唵哩瑟誐拏鉢囉舍娑多耶薩嚩怛他孽都瑟抳沙悉怛多鉢怛囉吽咄嚕唵 染婆曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 娑擔婆曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 謨訶曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 摩訶尾你也三婆叉拏羯哩吽咄嚕唵 ｜ 波囉尾你也三婆叉拏羯哩吽咄嚕唵 薩嚩耨瑟吒喃娑擔婆曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 薩嚩藥叉囉乞叉娑孽囉訶喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 左睹囉始底喃孽囉訶娑訶薩囉喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 ｜ 囉乞叉囉乞叉𤚥 婆誐鑁怛他孽都瑟抳沙悉怛多鉢怛囉摩訶嚩日嚧瑟抳沙摩訶鉢囉底揚擬囉摩訶娑訶薩囉部娑訶薩囉尸哩曬俱胝百千眼 阿陛你也入嚩多摩訶嚩日嚧娜囉底哩部嚩曩曼拏攞 唵娑嚩底婆嚩睹摩摩 ｜ 曳計質薩怛嚩摩摩阿呬帝史拏播跛質多嚕捺囉質多尾捺吠沙質多 尾你也嗔陀夜彌阿悉曩 枳攞夜彌嚩日囉拏 鉢哩嚩囉惹迦多尾你也嗔陀夜彌阿悉曩枳攞夜彌嚩日囉拏 荼吉尼多尾你也嗔陀夜彌阿悉曩枳攞夜彌嚩日囉拏 ｜ 叱陀你阿迦囉蜜哩柱般哩怛囉耶儜揭哩 怛你也他 唵阿那隸阿那隸尾舍提尾舍提鞞囉嚩日囉馱哩盤陀盤陀你嚩日囉謗尼泮 虎𤙖都嚧甕泮 娑嚩訶 唵薩嚩怛他孽都瑟抳沙悉怛多鉢怛囉吽泮吒吽媽媽吽抳娑嚩訶

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ | namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣāya | namo 'mitābhāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya | namo bhagavate vīra-vajradharāya sāgaranirghoṣāya tathāgatāya

recitationTipsZh: 原典古汉语音译：「曩莫薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩怛吠毗藥 曩謨婆誐嚩帝烏瑟抳沙耶 曩謨阿彌多婆耶怛他孽多夜囉訶帝三藐三沒馱耶 曩謨婆誐嚩帝尾囉嚩日囉馱囉耶娑誐囉捏具曬耶怛他孽多耶 ｜ 曩莫三曼多沒馱喃 唵悉怛多鉢怛囉烏瑟抳沙阿波囉爾帝缽囉底揚擬囉耶 薩嚩部多孽囉訶尼孽囉訶羯囉抳 波囉尾你也叱陀你 阿迦囉蜜哩底瑜鉢哩怛囉拏羯哩 ｜ 薩嚩滿馱曩目叉抳 薩嚩耨瑟吒耨娑嚩跛曩你嚩囉抳 左睹囉始底喃孽囉訶娑訶薩囉喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩 阿瑟吒尾舍底喃曩乞察怛囉喃鉢囉娑娜曩羯哩 ｜ 阿瑟吒喃摩訶孽囉訶喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩 薩嚩設咄嚧你嚩囉抳 具囉耨娑嚩跛曩喃左曩舍抳 尾沙設娑怛囉阿祇尼烏怛囉抳 ｜ 阿波囉爾多摩訶具囉摩訶婆囉摩訶戰拏摩訶你跛多摩訶帝惹摩訶濕吠多摩訶入嚩攞摩訶半拏囉嚩悉抳 阿哩耶多囉勃哩俱胝誓嚩尾惹耶嚩日囉摩禮底尾戍嚕多 ｜ 鉢訥摩迦嚩日囉爾訶嚩左摩攞誓嚩阿波囉爾多 嚩日囉難尾舍攞左扇多吠提訶布爾多 蘇彌耶嚕波摩訶濕吠多阿哩耶多囉摩訶婆囉 阿波囉嚩日囉商攞誓嚩嚩日囉俱摩哩俱藍馱哩 ｜ 嚩日囉訶娑多左摩訶尾你也建左曩摩迦 俱蘇婆囉怛曩誓嚩吠嚧左曩俱攞他娜烏瑟抳沙尾日哩婆摩拏左薩嚩日囉迦曩迦鉢囉婆路左曩 嚩日囉頓左濕吠多左迦摩攞乞叉舍尸鉢囉婆 ｜ 伊帝帝母捺囉誐拏薩吠囉乞叉俱嚩睹摩摩薩嚩薩怛嚩喃左 唵哩瑟誐拏鉢囉舍娑多耶薩嚩怛他孽都瑟抳沙悉怛多鉢怛囉吽咄嚕唵 染婆曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 娑擔婆曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 謨訶曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 摩訶尾你也三婆叉拏羯哩吽咄嚕唵 ｜ 波囉尾你也三婆叉拏羯哩吽咄嚕唵 薩嚩耨瑟吒喃娑擔婆曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 薩嚩藥叉囉乞叉娑孽囉訶喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 左睹囉始底喃孽囉訶娑訶薩囉喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 ｜ 囉乞叉囉乞叉𤚥 婆誐鑁怛他孽都瑟抳沙悉怛多鉢怛囉摩訶嚩日嚧瑟抳沙摩訶鉢囉底揚擬囉摩訶娑訶薩囉部娑訶薩囉尸哩曬俱胝百千眼 阿陛你也入嚩多摩訶嚩日嚧娜囉底哩部嚩曩曼拏攞 唵娑嚩底婆嚩睹摩摩 ｜ 曳計質薩怛嚩摩摩阿呬帝史拏播跛質多嚕捺囉質多尾捺吠沙質多 尾你也嗔陀夜彌阿悉曩 枳攞夜彌嚩日囉拏 鉢哩嚩囉惹迦多尾你也嗔陀夜彌阿悉曩枳攞夜彌嚩日囉拏 荼吉尼多尾你也嗔陀夜彌阿悉曩枳攞夜彌嚩日囉拏 ｜ 叱陀你阿迦囉蜜哩柱般哩怛囉耶儜揭哩 怛你也他 唵阿那隸阿那隸尾舍提尾舍提鞞囉嚩日囉馱哩盤陀盤陀你嚩日囉謗尼泮 虎𤙖都嚧甕泮 娑嚩訶 唵薩嚩怛他孽都瑟抳沙悉怛多鉢怛囉吽泮吒吽媽媽吽抳娑嚩訶」。上方已还原其悉昙梵字、天城梵文、现代梵音拼读与唐代行琳法师夹注音法。

recitationTipsZh: 原典古汉语音译：「曩莫薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩怛吠毗藥 曩謨婆誐嚩帝烏瑟抳沙耶 曩謨阿彌多婆耶怛他孽多夜囉訶帝三藐三沒馱耶 曩謨婆誐嚩帝尾囉嚩日囉馱囉耶娑誐囉捏具曬耶怛他孽多耶 ｜ 曩莫三曼多沒馱喃 唵悉怛多鉢怛囉烏瑟抳沙阿波囉爾帝缽囉底揚擬囉耶 薩嚩部多孽囉訶尼孽囉訶羯囉抳 波囉尾你也叱陀你 阿迦囉蜜哩底瑜鉢哩怛囉拏羯哩 ｜ 薩嚩滿馱曩目叉抳 薩嚩耨瑟吒耨娑嚩跛曩你嚩囉抳 左睹囉始底喃孽囉訶娑訶薩囉喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩 阿瑟吒尾舍底喃曩乞察怛囉喃鉢囉娑娜曩羯哩 ｜ 阿瑟吒喃摩訶孽囉訶喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩 薩嚩設咄嚧你嚩囉抳 具囉耨娑嚩跛曩喃左曩舍抳 尾沙設娑怛囉阿祇尼烏怛囉抳 ｜ 阿波囉爾多摩訶具囉摩訶婆囉摩訶戰拏摩訶你跛多摩訶帝惹摩訶濕吠多摩訶入嚩攞摩訶半拏囉嚩悉抳 阿哩耶多囉勃哩俱胝誓嚩尾惹耶嚩日囉摩禮底尾戍嚕多 ｜ 鉢訥摩迦嚩日囉爾訶嚩左摩攞誓嚩阿波囉爾多 嚩日囉難尾舍攞左扇多吠提訶布爾多 蘇彌耶嚕波摩訶濕吠多阿哩耶多囉摩訶婆囉 阿波囉嚩日囉商攞誓嚩嚩日囉俱摩哩俱藍馱哩 ｜ 嚩日囉訶娑多左摩訶尾你也建左曩摩迦 俱蘇婆囉怛曩誓嚩吠嚧左曩俱攞他娜烏瑟抳沙尾日哩婆摩拏左薩嚩日囉迦曩迦鉢囉婆路左曩 嚩日囉頓左濕吠多左迦摩攞乞叉舍尸鉢囉婆 ｜ 伊帝帝母捺囉誐拏薩吠囉乞叉俱嚩睹摩摩薩嚩薩怛嚩喃左 唵哩瑟誐拏鉢囉舍娑多耶薩嚩怛他孽都瑟抳沙悉怛多鉢怛囉吽咄嚕唵 染婆曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 娑擔婆曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 謨訶曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 摩訶尾你也三婆叉拏羯哩吽咄嚕唵 ｜ 波囉尾你也三婆叉拏羯哩吽咄嚕唵 薩嚩耨瑟吒喃娑擔婆曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 薩嚩藥叉囉乞叉娑孽囉訶喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 左睹囉始底喃孽囉訶娑訶薩囉喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 ｜ 囉乞叉囉乞叉𤚥 婆誐鑁怛他孽都瑟抳沙悉怛多鉢怛囉摩訶嚩日嚧瑟抳沙摩訶鉢囉底揚擬囉摩訶娑訶薩囉部娑訶薩囉尸哩曬俱胝百千眼 阿陛你也入嚩多摩訶嚩日嚧娜囉底哩部嚩曩曼拏攞 唵娑嚩底婆嚩睹摩摩 ｜ 曳計質薩怛嚩摩摩阿呬帝史拏播跛質多嚕捺囉質多尾捺吠沙質多 尾你也嗔陀夜彌阿悉曩 枳攞夜彌嚩日囉拏 鉢哩嚩囉惹迦多尾你也嗔陀夜彌阿悉曩枳攞夜彌嚩日囉拏 荼吉尼多尾你也嗔陀夜彌阿悉曩枳攞夜彌嚩日囉拏 ｜ 叱陀你阿迦囉蜜哩柱般哩怛囉耶儜揭哩 怛你也他 唵阿那隸阿那隸尾舍提尾舍提鞞囉嚩日囉馱哩盤陀盤陀你嚩日囉謗尼泮 虎𤙖都嚧甕泮 娑嚩訶 唵薩嚩怛他孽都瑟抳沙悉怛多鉢怛囉吽泮吒吽媽媽吽抳娑嚩訶」。上方已还原其悉昙梵字、天城梵文、现代梵音拼读与唐代行琳法师夹注音法。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 1 大数据库「CBETA《房山石经》陀罗尼专集」《一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼》（宋 契丹國師中天竺摩竭陀國三藏 慈賢 譯，卷 1，行号 0500a03）。本条含 0 组 <cb:tt> 梵汉逐字对音与 0 枚 #SD-* 悉昙外字；原典声韵夹注统计：二合 604 处、三合 21 处、引声 0 处、弹舌 0 处。
recitationTipsZh: 原典古汉语音译：「曩莫薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩怛吠毗藥 曩謨婆誐嚩帝烏瑟抳沙耶 曩謨阿彌多婆耶怛他孽多夜囉訶帝三藐三沒馱耶 曩謨婆誐嚩帝尾囉嚩日囉馱囉耶娑誐囉捏具曬耶怛他孽多耶 ｜ 曩莫三曼多沒馱喃 唵悉怛多鉢怛囉烏瑟抳沙阿波囉爾帝缽囉底揚擬囉耶 薩嚩部多孽囉訶尼孽囉訶羯囉抳 波囉尾你也叱陀你 阿迦囉蜜哩底瑜鉢哩怛囉拏羯哩 ｜ 薩嚩滿馱曩目叉抳 薩嚩耨瑟吒耨娑嚩跛曩你嚩囉抳 左睹囉始底喃孽囉訶娑訶薩囉喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩 阿瑟吒尾舍底喃曩乞察怛囉喃鉢囉娑娜曩羯哩 ｜ 阿瑟吒喃摩訶孽囉訶喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩 薩嚩設咄嚧你嚩囉抳 具囉耨娑嚩跛曩喃左曩舍抳 尾沙設娑怛囉阿祇尼烏怛囉抳 ｜ 阿波囉爾多摩訶具囉摩訶婆囉摩訶戰拏摩訶你跛多摩訶帝惹摩訶濕吠多摩訶入嚩攞摩訶半拏囉嚩悉抳 阿哩耶多囉勃哩俱胝誓嚩尾惹耶嚩日囉摩禮底尾戍嚕多 ｜ 鉢訥摩迦嚩日囉爾訶嚩左摩攞誓嚩阿波囉爾多 嚩日囉難尾舍攞左扇多吠提訶布爾多 蘇彌耶嚕波摩訶濕吠多阿哩耶多囉摩訶婆囉 阿波囉嚩日囉商攞誓嚩嚩日囉俱摩哩俱藍馱哩 ｜ 嚩日囉訶娑多左摩訶尾你也建左曩摩迦 俱蘇婆囉怛曩誓嚩吠嚧左曩俱攞他娜烏瑟抳沙尾日哩婆摩拏左薩嚩日囉迦曩迦鉢囉婆路左曩 嚩日囉頓左濕吠多左迦摩攞乞叉舍尸鉢囉婆 ｜ 伊帝帝母捺囉誐拏薩吠囉乞叉俱嚩睹摩摩薩嚩薩怛嚩喃左 唵哩瑟誐拏鉢囉舍娑多耶薩嚩怛他孽都瑟抳沙悉怛多鉢怛囉吽咄嚕唵 染婆曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 娑擔婆曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 謨訶曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 摩訶尾你也三婆叉拏羯哩吽咄嚕唵 ｜ 波囉尾你也三婆叉拏羯哩吽咄嚕唵 薩嚩耨瑟吒喃娑擔婆曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 薩嚩藥叉囉乞叉娑孽囉訶喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 左睹囉始底喃孽囉訶娑訶薩囉喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩吽咄嚕唵 ｜ 囉乞叉囉乞叉𤚥 婆誐鑁怛他孽都瑟抳沙悉怛多鉢怛囉摩訶嚩日嚧瑟抳沙摩訶鉢囉底揚擬囉摩訶娑訶薩囉部娑訶薩囉尸哩曬俱胝百千眼 阿陛你也入嚩多摩訶嚩日嚧娜囉底哩部嚩曩曼拏攞 唵娑嚩底婆嚩睹摩摩 ｜ 曳計質薩怛嚩摩摩阿呬帝史拏播跛質多嚕捺囉質多尾捺吠沙質多 尾你也嗔陀夜彌阿悉曩 枳攞夜彌嚩日囉拏 鉢哩嚩囉惹迦多尾你也嗔陀夜彌阿悉曩枳攞夜彌嚩日囉拏 荼吉尼多尾你也嗔陀夜彌阿悉曩枳攞夜彌嚩日囉拏 ｜ 叱陀你阿迦囉蜜哩柱般哩怛囉耶儜揭哩 怛你也他 唵阿那隸阿那隸尾舍提尾舍提鞞囉嚩日囉馱哩盤陀盤陀你嚩日囉謗尼泮 虎𤙖都嚧甕泮 娑嚩訶 唵薩嚩怛他孽都瑟抳沙悉怛多鉢怛囉吽泮吒吽媽媽吽抳娑嚩訶」。上方已还原其悉昙梵字、天城梵文、现代梵音拼读与唐代行琳法师夹注音法。

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ | namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣāya | namo 'mitābhāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya | namo bhagavate vīra-vajradharāya sāgaranirghoṣāya tathāgatāya
verses.meaningZh: 出自《房山石经·一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼》卷1「一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼」（第 1 句）
verses.meaningEn: From CBETA Fangshan Stone Canon F27n1063 (一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼) (Verse 1)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫薩嚩沒䭾冐地薩怛吠毗藥 曩謨婆誐嚩帝烏瑟抳沙耶 曩謨阿彌多婆耶怛他孽多夜囉訶帝三藐三沒馱耶 曩謨婆誐嚩帝尾囉嚩日囉馱囉耶娑誐囉捏具曬耶怛他孽多耶
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 604 · 三合 21 · 引 0 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: namaḥ samantabuddhānāṃ | oṃ sitātapatre uṣṇīṣa aparājite pratyangirāya | sarvabhūtagrahani-graha-karaṇī | para-vidyā-cchedanī | akāla-mṛtyu-paritrāṇa-karī
verses.meaningZh: 出自《房山石经·一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼》卷1「一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼」（第 2 句）
verses.meaningEn: From CBETA Fangshan Stone Canon F27n1063 (一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼) (Verse 2)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫三曼多沒馱喃 唵悉怛多鉢怛囉烏瑟抳沙阿波囉爾帝缽囉底揚擬囉耶 薩嚩部多孽囉訶尼孽囉訶羯囉抳 波囉尾你也叱陀你 阿迦囉蜜哩底瑜鉢哩怛囉拏羯哩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 604 · 三合 21 · 引 0 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: sarva-bandhana-mokṣaṇī | sarva-duṣṭa-duḥsvapna-nivāraṇī | caturaśītināṃ graha-sahasrāṇāṃ vidhvaṃsana-karī | aṣṭāviṃśatīnāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ prasādana-karī
verses.meaningZh: 出自《房山石经·一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼》卷1「一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼」（第 3 句）
verses.meaningEn: From CBETA Fangshan Stone Canon F27n1063 (一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼) (Verse 3)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩滿馱曩目叉抳 薩嚩耨瑟吒耨娑嚩跛曩你嚩囉抳 左睹囉始底喃孽囉訶娑訶薩囉喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩 阿瑟吒尾舍底喃曩乞察怛囉喃鉢囉娑娜曩羯哩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 604 · 三合 21 · 引 0 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: aṣṭānāṃ mahā-grahāṇāṃ vidhvaṃsana-karī | sarva-śatru-nivāraṇī | ghoraṃ duḥsvapnānāṃ ca nāśanī | viṣa-śastra-agni-uttaraṇī
verses.meaningZh: 出自《房山石经·一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼》卷1「一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼」（第 4 句）
verses.meaningEn: From CBETA Fangshan Stone Canon F27n1063 (一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼) (Verse 4)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿瑟吒喃摩訶孽囉訶喃尾特呁薩曩羯哩 薩嚩設咄嚧你嚩囉抳 具囉耨娑嚩跛曩喃左曩舍抳 尾沙設娑怛囉阿祇尼烏怛囉抳

verses.iast: aparājitā mahā-ghorā mahā-balā mahā-caṇḍā mahā-dīptā mahā-tejā mahā-śvetā mahā-jvalā mahā-pāṇḍaravāsinī | ārya-tārā bhṛkuṭī ceva vijaya vajra-māleti viśrutā
verses.meaningZh: 出自《房山石经·一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼》卷1「一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼」（第 5 句）
verses.meaningEn: From CBETA Fangshan Stone Canon F27n1063 (一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼) (Verse 5)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿波囉爾多摩訶具囉摩訶婆囉摩訶戰拏摩訶你跛多摩訶帝惹摩訶濕吠多摩訶入嚩攞摩訶半拏囉嚩悉抳 阿哩耶多囉勃哩俱胝誓嚩尾惹耶嚩日囉摩禮底尾戍嚕多

verses.iast: padmaṃka vajra-jihva ca mālā-cevāparājitā | vajra-daṇḍī viśālā ca śānta-vaideha-pūjitā | saumya-rūpā mahā-śvetā ārya-tārā mahā-balā | aparā vajra-śaṅkalā ceva vajra-kaumārī kulandharī
verses.meaningZh: 出自《房山石经·一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼》卷1「一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼」（第 6 句）

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢訥摩迦嚩日囉爾訶嚩左摩攞誓嚩阿波囉爾多 嚩日囉難尾舍攞左扇多吠提訶布爾多 蘇彌耶嚕波摩訶濕吠多阿哩耶多囉摩訶婆囉 阿波囉嚩日囉商攞誓嚩嚩日囉俱摩哩俱藍馱哩

verses.iast: vajra-hastā ca mahā-vidyā kāñcana-mālikā | kusumbha-ratnā ceva vairocanā kulāthadā uṣṇīṣa vijṛmbhamāṇā ca savajra-kanaka-prabhā-locanā | vajra-tuṇḍī ca śvetā ca kamalākṣā śaśi-prabhā
verses.meaningZh: 出自《房山石经·一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼》卷1「一切如來白傘蓋大佛頂陀羅尼」（第 7 句）

recitationTipsZh: 原典古汉语音译：「古者能仁氏之王堪忍也始獲正覺談教法 以度僧伽之眾三寶於是乎現馬埋世霧之 六師薎如霜殞麗義天之五教朗若日懸然 有樂廣之徒慕博知而常說尚略之輩希捷 見以勤行人既二類不同法遂兩端亦異為 樂廣廣開性相曲示於淵玄對尚略略啟呪 名直增於功德其性也實多詮真理少議俗 事其相也權多議俗事少詮真理其呪也密 多從笁語少就支音其名也顯多就支音少 從笁語勃陁住世四十九年年別續演達磨 䟽歧一十二分分各無叅論夫析奧之幽其 閒甚眾議乃拯淪之急唯此為先生死浪由 是乎涸乾圓寂峯以之而峭峻。 今我聦文聖武英略神功睿哲仁孝皇帝陛 下承祧以立為世而來乘宿敦菩薩之因據 現感皇王之位體佛在之正化闡佛後之遺 風俯控外氓闢三學於三府高提內吒傳六 明於六宮」。上方已还原其悉昙梵字、天城梵文、现代梵音拼读与唐代行琳法师夹注音法。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第4品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (4): mānuṣāsuraguruḍagandharvvaśca lokobhagavato bhāṣita matyandāmmiti
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (4): mānuṣāsuraguruḍagandharvvaśca lokobhagavato bhāṣita matyandāmmiti
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 4: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (4): mānuṣāsuraguruḍagandharvvaśca lokobhagavato bhāṣita matyandāmmiti
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §4
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (4)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 4 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：mānuṣāsuraguruḍagandharvvaśca lokobhagavato bhāṣita matyandāmmiti|| || āryya pacavigaṁtikā prajñāpāramitā nāmadhāraṇī parisamāpta|| ye dharmmā ityādi|| || oṁ namo bhavatyai āryya prajñāpāramitārye|| evaṁ mayā śruta meka sminsamaye bhagavānrājagṛhe viharatisma| gṛddhekūṭyeparvvatemahatā bhikṣusaṁghaśataicanekaircbodhisatvakoṭī niyutaśata sahasraḥ śakra prakṣya lokepāra pramurkhecane kaiśca deva manuṣāyā sura koṭī śata sahasraiḥ pramukhaiśca parivṛttaḥ|| śrīratna gadarbha (dva) siṁhā sena nisugṇaḥ bhagavā dharmma deśayātisma|| ādoca kalyāṇaṁ madhyekalyāṇa paryyavasāne kalyāṇaṁ svarthaṁsuvyajjanaṁ kevalaṁ paripurṇṇapariśuddha parthyavadātaṁ praṣkaca ryya saṁprakāśayatisma| athakhalvāryyā va lokiteśvaro bodhisatvo mahāsatvaḥ utthā(stha) pāśanādekāśaimuttarā saṁgaṁkṛtvā dakṣiṇa jānuma。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (6): vaṁśeyasyāsīdāyurekaṁśata mihasaradāṁsarvvalokaikabaddhoṣa nirjityāśecca mulesurucimāpisadānunta rāyenavodhistaṁvandeśo sihaṁsurana ranamitaṁ buddhamādityabaṁdhu
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 6: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (6): vaṁśeyasyāsīdāyurekaṁśata mihasaradāṁsarvvalokaikabaddhoṣa nirjityāśecca mulesurucimāpisadānunta rāyenavodhistaṁvandeśo sihaṁsurana ranamitaṁ buddhamādityabaṁdhu
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §6
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (6)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 6 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：vaṁśeyasyāsīdāyurekaṁśata mihasaradāṁsarvvalokaikabaddhoṣa nirjityāśecca mulesurucimāpisadānunta rāyenavodhistaṁvandeśo sihaṁsurana ranamitaṁ buddhamādityabaṁdhu|| jātiviprapraśaṣṭhu nṛpavaramahite ketumahyāṁgṛhītvā buddhatvaṁyaḥ kariṣyatyāmita guṇanidhirnnāga vṛkṣasyamule| aṣṭāvavdāyutānikṣa pitabhagavate bhāviyagramāyu rvvandemaitrayanāthaṁtuṣita puravarāvāskitaṁ taṁmunīndraṁ|| stutvāvi saptabuddhansakalamupagatānsa ptasaptārksa bhāsometrayaṁbāṣumaṁmetuṣita puragataṁbhā vitaṁlokanātha| yatpupyaṁsaṁprasuta tubhagatiphala dadahināmeva sarvvācchitvā saṁlkeśayāśo nmunayaśvavarāniṣṭati saṁprayāntu|| itisugatā vadānasapta buddha muni samāptaḥ oṁ namaḥ sarvabuddha bodhisatvānāṁ mulāmūlahālakā nantā sukṣataḥ sarvvajinā-asimaniṣṭha| varadāmamadhantu abhyudā|。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 7 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：lambaramatrāṁmamasarvvadā anantatasyavayāpadā arara asamantānanta dharmātekhana 3 mahāvīrapastra samasahamahāvarakaṇṇara mahābalokite ha ha ra vajavajārkaradhara rū hūṃ hūṃ maṇulamavarāgra vikamakurutsurūsarvatathā hijyala agrā-agriṇīphaṭ svāhā| imūlavidhāmantrasiddhimādhāraṇī samāptaḥ oṁ namo buddha-āya|| oṁ namo bhagavate vairocana prabhaketu buddha-āya|| tayathā|| oṁ śuṣkera samayara śānte 2 dānte 2 samā-ū pe-anālaṁvetaramveja sobhavanti mahātejenilālamve nilākūlanirvvāṇesa vve buddhānāṁdhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhite svāhā| itivaiśacanāmadhāraṇī samākaṁ|| oṁ namo bhagavate āryya śrā-akṣobhyāyatabhāgatā yā rhate。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第8品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (8): 1) iti akṣobha nāma dhāranī
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (8): 1) iti akṣobha nāma dhāranī
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 8: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (8): 1) iti akṣobha nāma dhāranī
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §8
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (8)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 8 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：1) iti akṣobha nāma dhāranī samāpta|| oṁ namo bhagavate ratneka tu nājāyatamadhāna tāyārhama samyaṁka vjjāya| tayathā oṁ vatte|| 2) mahāvastre ratne saṁbhave svāhā| iti ratne saṁbhavanā dharanī samāpta| oṁ nāmo bhagavate amitāthācā tatha-āgatāyārbhame samyaṁkka buddhāya| 3) tayaṁthā|| oṁ amine' amitobhave amitasiṁddhe amitamini amitagagana kirtīikare sarvāthī siddhe nama savvekarmā kesakasa| 4) kṣayakīra svāhā| iti amitābhasya nāma dhāranī samāpta| oṁ namo bhagavate amoghe siśyu tathāgatā mārhamame samyaṁka buddhāya| 5) tayathā|| oṁ siddhatu bhūmiṁddha parama siddhe svāhā| iti amogha siddhī nāma dhāranī samāpta| oṁ nama dhī majjñā nāthāya| oṁ namo bhagavate| 6) candra vajja kroṭāya| tayathā| bhava| tu, karatu, tiṣṭhatu, vandatu, haratu, amṛteta huṃ, huṃ, ha, phaṭ svāhā|| iti amṛta bhakṣānāma dhāranī samāpta || iti||。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第9品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (9): oṁ namaḥ śrīmaṁjunāthāya
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (9): oṁ namaḥ śrīmaṁjunāthāya
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 9: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (9): oṁ namaḥ śrīmaṁjunāthāya
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §9
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (9)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 9 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：oṁ namaḥ śrīmaṁjunāthāya|| oṁ namo-arapañacanāyamukatidahanadakṣāyamaṁjuśrīpradātāyacandrakāntimaṇibuddhipradāyākhaṅaga pustakavyagrahastāyamaṁjuvāṇivaraprudāyasarvvasatvānāṁñaca śāntiṁkurūpuṣṭikururakṣākurū oṁ āḥ dhīḥ hūṁ phaṭ-svāhā| iti-arapañacanamaṁjuśrīḥ sādhananāmadhāraṇīsamāptaḥ|| oṁ namaḥ śākyasiṁhāya|| tadyathā| oṁ dhṛtiśrutivijayesvāhā|| namostuhabuddhāya suviśuddhabodhayeviśuddhadharmmāpratibhānubuddhe| saddharmma punyāpagatā nuddhayebhavāgraśunpāpariśuddhabuddhaye|| aho aho buddhamanakṣatejasaṁ aho aho sāgaramerū| aho aho buddhamanantagocaraṁ āṃdunvaṁraṁ puṣa-apamivāti dullabhaṁ|| aho aho kāṇikastathāgataḥ śākyakulatunarendrasūryyāyenedṛśaṁbhāṣita- sutramubhumaṁsarvaṣusatvāmanugrahārtha|| śa-ānteśa-avaraḥ śākyamunistathāgataḥ satvobhumaḥ gāntapurepraviṣṭhaḥ||。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第10品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (10): maitrīnātha-ātha
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (10): maitrīnātha-ātha
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 10: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (10): maitrīnātha-ātha
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §10
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (10)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 10 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：sakma || 10|| itisūvarṇtra prabhāyāṁkuleva tā ti samāpta|| oṁ māyā jāla saparivāraye hūṃ|| itimāyājāla mantra gāthā|| ye dharmo-ityādi|| || || oṁ namāmaitrīsiṁhāya|| oṁ namaḥ śrī maitrīyabodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākārakāyakāya| namo bhagavate śākyamunateyetathāgatāyārhate samyakayaṁ buddhāya|| tayathā|| oṁ ajite' mahāmāhisvapāhā|| mati' mahāmahisvāhā|| iti śrī maitrīnātha-ātha|| bhāvaviyāvaraṇa sampannaḥ samyakakaṁ buddhāyasarva satvārtha pravitracikā puṇya dhupa dipa gandhane vidyasaṁsārā duḥ。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第11品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (11): khāṅatanuttarāya sampakkaṁ bodhau pratiṣṭhāya
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (11): khāṅatanuttarāya sampakkaṁ bodhau pratiṣṭhāya

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 11 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：khāṅatanuttarāya sampakkaṁ bodhau pratiṣṭhāya|| ji āḥ maitreya hūṃ svāhā| iti maitrīya nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| 23|| ḍenamaḥ śrīlokanāthāya|| amogha pāśāyanamaḥ|| evaṁmayā śrutamekasmiṁ samaye bhagavān protarakeparvvate viharatisma|| āryyāva lokiteśvaraspabhavane| aneka śāsagatamāsa campakāśa-okātimukta kanānānāratnavṛkṣa samalaṁkṛtemahatābhikṣū saṁghenasārddha aṣṭādaśabhirbhikṣa sahasrairnavanavati bhiścabodhisatva koṭiniyuteśatasahasraiḥ parivṛttaḥ puraskṛta iśvara maheśvara vraphnta kāyikāṁ deva putrā nādha-ikṛtya dharmmadeśayatisma|| athakhalvāryyāca lokiteśvaro bodhisatvo mahāsatvotchāyāsanādekāṁśa muttarā saṅgakṛtvāda kṣiṇajā majulaṁ pṛthiṣyā pratiṣṭha-āpyayenabhagavāṁsta nāñajalīkṛtvāpraṇya prahasita vadano bhūtvā bhagavanta meta davocata|| astima mebhaṁga。

translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §12

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 12 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：na vyuhaṁnāma samādhiṁ prati labhate| yadi-icchati tatkarotyeva śādhaka iti|| idamavocad bhagavānāttamanā āryāva lokiteśvaro bodhisatvo mahāsatvastaca bhikṣavastaica bodhisatvā satcaśuddhāvā sakā-īka devapūtrā sadeva mānūṣā saragaruḍa gandharvvaśca lokobha gavatoṣitamabhya nandanniti|| iti āryā smoghapāśanāma hṛdayaṁmahāyāna sūtraṁ nāmadhāraṇāṁ parisamāptaḥ oṁ namaḥ śrīlokanāthāya|| oṁ namaḥ śrīkhasarpyanāyai| trailokya darpyanātha ekāgracittā cittāya sakala lokavināsana karāya sarvasatvānātrya śānti kurupūṣṭiṁ kururakṣā kurusiddhiṁ kuru-oṁ āḥ hṛṁ hu phaṭ svāhā|| āryā khasarpyanāmadhāraṇī samāpta| oṁ namaḥ trailokanātha|| oṁ namo bhagavate āryāva lokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya|| tadyathā oṁsūmūṣṭi chedani nirmmaresū。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 14 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：verocana vyusarājāpaya tathāgatārhate samyakaṁ buddhāya| tadyathā| nama| sarva tathāgatetatya| samyakaṁ buddhāyatya| namaḥ āryāvajñokī| teśvarāya bodhisatvāya| mahāsatvāya| mahākārūṇikāya| taghayā| oṁ dhara tu dhirītu ṣar-tu bhadrevatu, pracajñetu kusumetu vane| iti bhilici| li vajjālā pranaye svāhā| ārya śrī sabhamra bhujalokeśvarasya nāma dhāranī samāpta| oṁ nama, śrī siṁha nādāya| namoratna namāya| namo āryāvalo kiṁteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya, mahākāruṇikāya| taghayā| oṁ akaṭe, vikaṭe, nikaṭe, ikaṭe| kaṭaṁkaṭa kaloka karāṭavīryva| svāhā| āryā siṁhanādalokeśvara nāma dhāranī samāpta| oṁ namo mokṣa padāya| oṁ nama śrī āryāvajño kineśvarāya, bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya, mahākāruṇikāya| tadyathā| oṁ yajñetu, cilītu, culutu, hayutu m。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第15品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (15): tu 2 hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ padamahastāya svāhā
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (15): tu 2 hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ padamahastāya svāhā
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 15: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (15): tu 2 hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ padamahastāya svāhā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §15
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (15)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 15 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：tu 2 hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ padamahastāya svāhā|| āryya mokṣa prada nāmadhāraṇī samāptaḥ|| 29|| oṁ namaḥ śrī āryāva lokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya|| tadyathā| oṁ viśuddhāgreśuddhā kṣi śodhani gagaṇa viśodhanivittī viśodhani-ā valaṇaviśodhani karmmaviraṇa viśodhanihana 2 sarvvā caraṇānipaca 2 patrcanantaryyā padma padmākṣi padma vimale ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi ha ha ha ha ha arjja ladare siddhirisvāhā|| paṭhita mātreṇa patrcanapatrcanantarythāṇi karmmāṇi parikṣayaṁcāsyanti|| āryāva lokiteśvarasya siddhinikānāmadhāraṇī samāptaḥ|| 30|| oṁ namoṣaṅkṣarāya oṁ namo āryāva lokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākārūṇikāya|| evanmayā śṛta mekasminsamaye bhagavāna śrāvastyāṁ viharatisma|| jetavane'nāthapiṇḍasyārāme tatra khalu bhagavānāyuṣmaṁta。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第16品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (16): bhate
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (16): bhate
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 16: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (16): bhate
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §16
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (16)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 16 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：bhate|| ānanda paurāṇāṁsa tyathatāṣitekarmma vivākaṁ|| ida mavocadbhagavānattamanā āyuṣyānā nando bhagavato bhāṣita matya nandanniti|| āryya ṣaḍakṣarī mahāviyānāma dhāraṇī samāptaḥ|| 31|| oṁ namo nīlakaṇṭha lokaśvarāya|| oṁ namo āryyā valokiteśvarāya bodhita-ūttvāya| mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya| tadyathā|| oṁ maṇi padme hūṃ|| oṁ sarvva bandhanache danakarāya| sarvapāpa samudrocheṣanakarāya sarvvavyādhipraśesana karāya| sarvvabhyu padravanināśanakarāya| sarvva bhayeṣutrāṇāya| tasmenamaskṛtaṁ| iti āryyā valokiteśvarasya stavanīlakaṇṭha nāma hṛday āryyāvirtt-yiṣyāmi| sarvvārthasādhana śubhavetanaṁ| sarvva satvā nāṁpāpamārgja viśodhakaḥ|| tadyathā|| avalokiḍata lokatalokagati-ehe mahābodhisatva he prīya bodhisatva dekālunikalpa hṛdayaṁ ehe āryyā valokiteśvara paramamaitrī vittka ruṇika kukarmma sādhanīvi。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第17品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (17): ṇaṁ prasādhayamesvāhā
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (17): ṇaṁ prasādhayamesvāhā
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 17: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (17): ṇaṁ prasādhayamesvāhā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §17
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (17)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 17 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ṇaṁ prasādhayamesvāhā|| siddhāyasvāhā|| varāhamukhāyasvāhā|| mahāpadmahastāya svāhā|| vajrahastāya svāhā|| mahāvajrahastāya svāhā|| kṛṣṇasarvyatayajñāpavītāya svāhā|| mahākālamakūṭadharāya svāhā|| cakrāyūdhadharāyasvāhā|| śaṁkhaśadvanirnno danakarāya svāhā|| bodhanakarāya svāhā|| vāmaskandha deśaskidata kṛṣṇā jināya svāhā|| vāmahastavyāghracarmma nivāsanāya svāhā| lokeśvarāya svāhā|| mahālokeśvarāya svāhā|| sarva siddheśvarāya svāhā|| namāṁ svāhā|| kurūrakṣā mūrtiṇāṁ svāhā|| namo bhagavate āryyā valokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāyamāstvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya siddha yumemakantra padāvisvāhā|| itiśrī āryyāvalokiteśvara sya nīla kaṇṭha hṛdayaṁ sāmaptaḥ||32|| oṁ namo padmahastāya|| oṁ namo āryyāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahasatvā|。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第18品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (18): yamahākāruṇikāya
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (18): yamahākāruṇikāya
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 18: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (18): yamahākāruṇikāya
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §18
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (18)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 18 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：yamahākāruṇikāya|| tadyathā|| oṁ cara 2 ciri 2 cura 2 ha 2 mur 2 huṃ huṃ huṃ huṃ huṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā|| padmahastāya svārha āryya padmahastadhāraṇī samāptaḥ|| 33|| oṁ namo sahasravarktāya|| oṁ namo āryyāvilokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya|| tadyathā|| oṁ jaya 2 mahājaya- vāhinijayoktarikala 2 mara 2 cara 2 hadu 2 kṣiṇi sarvvakarmmāvalanānima ma bhagavati sahasrāvarbhṛma| sarvva buddhava lokita cakṣustrota jivhā manovijñāna viśonila|| tadyathā|| || oṁ surū 2 prasurū 2 bhara 2 sambhara 2 phara 2 smara 2 oṁ sarvva buddhādhiṣṭhite svāhā|| oṁ sarvva buddhalikite svāhā|| oṁ dharmādhātū garbhbesvāhā|| oṁ abhāvasvabhāva dharmmāvabodhani svāhā|| āryya sahasravarktānāma (varttānāma) dhāraṇī samāptaḥ|| 34|| oṁ namo lokanāthāya|| oṁ maṇipadma huṃ|| oṁ kāra dhyānayogaṁvara kamala。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 19 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：rasapta miśrana saṁyukta ṣaḍakṣarasatva samāptaḥ|| 35|| oṁ namo lokanāthāya namaste bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāyatāpine| āryyāva lokiteśāya maheśvarāya suśriye||1|| padmaśrī bhuṣitā ya saddharmmavacadāyate namāva śaṁkarāya truvanadṛṣṭika nāyate|| 2|| sarvadā jagadāśvāsavara dāna pradāyaca| śata sahamrahastāya koṭīlakṣekṣaṇāyaca|| 3|| vaḍavā mukha paryyanta śaśidiśāna nāyaca| sarva dharmmānurupāya dharmma priyāṁya suddhiye|| 4|| sarvva satva mahā duḥkha saṁmokṣaṇa karāyaca| matsya dayāmbujūja mṛnāmā śvāsana karāyacaṁ||5|| jñāna rāśṣutta māṁgāya dharmmārtha priyadāyine| ratna śrī bhuṣitāṁtyāya saṅṇa śrī pradāyaca||6|| sarvva naraka bhumīnāṁ saṁśoṣaṇa karāyaca| jñāna śrī saṁprabhāsāya jñāna laṣkī pradāyaca|| sāmaraiḥ sāsurendreśvalokaiḥ saṁpūjitāyaca namaḥ。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 20 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ye vajapāṇi mahāyakṣa vijadaṇakarāyaca||17|| trai loke dusatvānī bhīṣaṇa mūrtti dhāriṇe| bhutacetā ekūmbhāṇura kṣoyakṣā dibhī da de|| 18|| nilotyala khunatrāya gambhīcadhīca buddhaye| sarvva dhinā thāya sarvva kle śopāriṇe|| bhūvi vidharmma sambā dhimārgoya citāyaca| mokṣa bhārgā bhiruḍhāya pravaradhamma pitrute|| 20|| prāpta saṁbodhi saccitta sanmārgo pacitāyaca| pretā didurgati kleśa parimokṣaṇa karāyaca||21|| paramoṇu rajo saṁkhya samādhida dhate namaḥ| nama mtrai laukanāthāya bodhisatvāya tesadā|| 22|| mahāsatvāya saddharmma guṇa saṁpaktidāyine| namāmi tejaga chāstā sadāhaṁ śaraṇaṁ vrajate||23|| bhajābhisatavaṁbhakkāta tprasadi jagatprabho| kṣanta vyaṁme rādhatvaṁyatmathā prakṛtaṁbhavet||24|| itiśrī madā ryyā va lokiteśvara spajamacā jā muti samāptaḥ|| oṁ na mo loka。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 21 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：nāthāya|| namehaṁ bhagavanchāstre va lokite śvarāyate| padmabhṛte maheśāya sū pralhāda karāyaca||1|| padmāsanāya padmaśrī pariṣṭata samūktaye| saṁśubha padmahastāya jagadāśvā sadāyine||2|| pṛthivī carane trāya saṁśuddha patrvacakṣuṣa| jinaratna kirīṭāya cintāmaṇi vibhūṣiṇa||3|| itimaheśvarakṛta stavaḥ|| namehaṁ bhagavanchāstreve lokite śvarāyate| maheśāya jagabhartta prāṇadāya mahātmate||1|| pṛthivīvarane trāyaṁ śubhapadmadharāyaca| padmaśrī pariṣṭatāya sūcetana karāyaca||2|| dharmmadharāya nāthāya daśabhūmīśvarāya cāsū nirvṛtti mahāyāna saṁprasthitāya sarvvadā||3|| iti āryyāvalokiteśvarasya umāmaheśvara kṛtmṇati samāptaṁ||3|| oṁ namaḥ samatra bhadrāya|| atha khalū samanta bhadro bodhisatva mmahāsatva etāneva loka dhātu paraṁparona bhilā pyānābhilāpya būddha kṣatrapara。

verses.iast: nogatiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC《陀罗尼集》第 21 品《Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (21): nāthāya》（第 1 句）

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第22品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (22): pariṇampayadāpta puṇṣamana kamatīvaviśiṣṭaṁ| tenajagadvya sanoghati magnaṁ yātvamitābha purīvaramaca
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (22): pariṇampayadāpta puṇṣamana kamatīvaviśiṣṭaṁ| tenajagadvya sanoghati magnaṁ yātvamitābha purīvaramaca
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 22: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (22): pariṇampayadāpta puṇṣamana kamatīvaviśiṣṭaṁ| tenajagadvya sanoghati magnaṁ yātvamitābha purīvaramaca
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §22
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (22)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 22 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：pariṇampayadāpta puṇṣamana kamatīvaviśiṣṭaṁ| tenajagadvya sanoghati magnaṁ yātvamitābha purīvaramaca|| || āryyabhadravarīmahāpraṇidhāna ratna rājaṁ samāptaṁ|| || oṁ namo lokathāya|| oṁ namaḥ śrī āryyā va lokiteśvarāya|| bodhisatvāyamahā satvāya mahākāruṇikāya|| evaṁmayā śṛta me kasminsamaye bhagavānāryyāvalokiteṇṣaṭasya bhagavate pāṭarake parvvata śikharayarānāratna vṛkṣasahasra samādhi vyakīrṇte jāmvanade suvarṇtukāctrenobhāsa|| nānāratnamaya vimāna bhūmipradeśa viharātisma|| anekaiśvadevanāgayakṣa suragaruḍa kinnara mahoragamatuṣyā koṭi niyūta śata sasamraiḥ sārddha tatrakhalū bhagavānū puraskṛta smaṁskṛtī gurūkṛto mānitaḥ pūjito ardhito apacāyito parivūta dharmma deśayatisma|| ādaukalyānaṁ madhaukalyānaṁ paryyavasāṇakaṁsyā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第23品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (23): suryyasahasrātireka tejā ruciraśarīre vraṣkendādine maskate iti
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (23): suryyasahasrātireka tejā ruciraśarīre vraṣkendādine maskate iti
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 23: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (23): suryyasahasrātireka tejā ruciraśarīre vraṣkendādine maskate iti
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §23
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (23)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 23 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：suryyasahasrātireka tejā ruciraśarīre vraṣkendādine maskate iti|| || yaḥ kaścidāryāvalokite śvaraspanāmāṣṭotara śatenamtrotrā pahārakuryyotātaspatrca nannataryyāṇikarmmācaraṇāni parikṣayaṁ gacchati|| sarvvamāgulaṁ praviṣṭhobhavanti| sarvva mantrānita spasiddhānita| aneka kalpa koṭhiniyuta satasahasrāṇi durgatinnajārā|| avicīna praviśaṁti| tasyacamaraṇa kālasamaye sutvāvatyāṁloka dhātu dhupa yadyaṁte|| jātojātau āryyāvalokiteśaravirahito bhavanti|| samatrajāpena medhāvī bhavati|| śurāśurayaḥ savaraḥ sarvva śāsta viśārada ā deyavāṣṭo bhavati|| anenamtotrā pahāraṁ kuryyāta dvāṣaṣṭhī gargānadīyālukāsamoyu būddhā bhagavanta pujito bhavanti|| samovipākonā ṣṭi viśe| sarvvajñajina ratnadhātu karaṇukaṁnāma bhagavanta āryyālokiteśvara spa-aṣṭobhāra śatanāma mahāyāna śūtraṁ samāptaṁ||0||。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第24品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (24): kha svāhā
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (24): kha svāhā
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 24: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (24): kha svāhā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §24
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (24)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 24 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：kha svāhā|| oṁ kuvaleya svāhā|| oṁ jūṃ jūṃ jūṃ śiva svāhā|| oṁ urddhaṣnuṇe svāhā|| oṁ suryyāya grahādhipataye svāhā|| oṁ candāyārakṣatrādhipataye svāhā|| adhipṛthivyai svāhā|| oṁ asurebhyaḥ svāhā|| oṁ nāgebhyaḥ svāhā|| oṁ sarvvayogecittamu pātpādayāmī samudraphalanasamaye haṃ asamācara samīrasāra dharmminaḥ karuṇātmakaḥ jagaduḥkhahānathaḥ|| asamanta sarva guṇāsiddhi dāyine|| asamāṁcara samīra sāra dharmminaḥ karuṇātmakaḥ jagaduḥkhahānayaḥ|| samanta sarva guṇāsiddhidāyine|| asamāṁcasamavarāgra dharmmiṇaḥ gagaṇe samāpatatānavidyate|| guṇaresareṇū- kanikaṁvyasimiko sphutasatvadhātuvara siddhidāyakaṁ|| vigato prareṣu-asamanta siddhipuśatatāmalokanavega taddhitā praṇidhāna siddhibala nirodhaḥ dharmmatājagatārtha sādhanaparāḥ samattini satatṣvi rocani mahā kṛpātmamānanirodhātmakaruṣācārī kāyarotavajatetrīsokavara siddhidāyakāḥ amitābhateṣu samāpti tamatāḥ sata。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第25品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section (25)
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section (25)
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 25: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section (25)
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §25
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (25)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 25 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：|| āryā sarvva dūrgnati pariśo dhanarājyasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyakaṁ būḍacasya kalpaika samāptaḥ|| oṁ namo ratnatracāya|| oṁ namaḥ sarvva buddha bodhisatvebhaḥ|| tadyathā|| oṁ kinira tathāgato dbhabaśānta bala daṁḍattama tathāgato dabhabahūṃ phaṭ svāhā āryya gandhavyū hanāmadhāraśāṁ samāptaḥ oṁ namo ratnatrayāya tadyathā|| ḍaṁdhana 2 hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā āryya samādhi rājanāma dhāraṇī samāptaḥ|| oṁ namoca laṁkāya tārāya|| buddhe bhagabadbhe rbhāṣitā nibhāṣiṣante|| tadyathā|| oṁ ṭṭa 2 dhūṭṭa 2 kaṭa 2 amale 2 vimale 2 nima 2 vame 2 kase 2 aṭamaṭṭaka gholathapagho dimera paca 2 vandha 2 ace 2 mace dūtāre dūśovatāre arkkara sarkka 2 vakre 2 dime 2 ṭūṭūṭūṭū|| ḍū ḍū ḍū ḍū|| rū rū rū rū|| phū phū phū phū svāhā|| āryya laṁkābatāra pathi phalanāma dhāraṇīsamā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 26: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (26): ptaḥ
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §26
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (26)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 26 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ptaḥ|| oṁ namoratna trayāya|| namaḥ sarvabuddha kodhisatve| bodhisatvesyaḥ|| namo aṣṭa mahābhayapurgarāya namaḥ saptasyaḥ samyakkaṁ buddhasyaḥ|| tayathā|| oṁ hṛ hṛḥ hṛḥ hṛ sarvvanāṇā nāṁ sarvva sekulānāṁ hana 2 śarana tādya 2 utparenabhito nāma bhayadahipralaya kāla ivavaja dharama vatā 2 varṣanto nāgāanayasi kuruphaḥ kālāya 2 phu phuḥ|| oṁ kurukuraptīḥ ptu phaṭ svāhā|| āryya ṣṭha mahā dū bhayapurgala nāma dhāraśrī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namo jidhtārstararā jāya tathāgatā yārha te samyakkaṁ vuścāya|| tayathā|| oṁ vara 2 dhara 2 dhāraṇi 2 sarvvaratnā vallaki te sarvva ratna dhāraṇi sarvva ratna prati manvitaśarī re svāhā|| āryyaktarṇu jopānāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namo bhagavato sarva pāyadahana vajāyatathāgatā yārha te samyakkaṁ buddhāya|| tayathā|| uṁ vaje 2 mahavajimī yasvāhā|| āryya sarvvapāpadahana nāyadhā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 27 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：dharaṇī samāptaḥ|| || oṁ namo vaja sarasvasye|| vajasamāja yudreyā|| oṁ vaja samājaḥ jaḥ ja jñāna satvapravasādi pūrvvaka prajñāyā ramitā vaja paryyarka samāsirā bhāvayat|| oṁ pivu 2 prajñābaddha nivdāla 2 spadhāvaddha nidhiri 2 buddhi baddha nisvāhā|| āryya pajasarasvatī 1 nāmadhāraṇī samāpta|| oṁ namo bhagavate suvarṇu prabhā indrarājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya|| tayathā|| oṁ ptu ṭini 2 amitākta sani-ayiniyiriṇi svāhā|| āryya puṇya vibaddhanī nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namo saddharmma yuśra| puśra rīktāya|| namo ratna trayāya|| namaḥ prabhūgaratnādi sarvva tathāgatān monamaḥ| namo śākta munaye tathāgatā yārhate samyakaṁka buddhāya tayathā|| ane 2 arau dharau amane mamanacilkatta varite| samasamitā viśānta mukta mukte yasame avisane sabhejayajaya akṣimeśā||。

translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)

deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (28)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 28 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ante amitedhāraṇi ālokabhāmya pratyavākṣa ni ni dhi rucū viru-atyanta 2 ni vicha anta 2 yā ri vi śuddhi ukūle mūkūle araḍe paraḍe sūkākṣi asame same būddha vilokite dharmma parikṣipratya vākṣini sadyanidaryasa nidyoṣanimayā bhaya vinodhani|| mantre mantrā kṣaya te nūta kauśalya-a kṣayavanatā vakkulava ratāyavaloka amanpatāya|| tadyathā|| jvale mahājvale ubhyabhūko aḍa-a ḍovati nṛtya nṛtyāvati yiḍi ni vidrū viprū nṛtyarinṛtyāvati|| tadyathā|| aṭṭa bh naṭṭa venadṛ avadya nā vikūna yisvādā|| tadyathā|| agaṇe gaṇe gaurīgāṁdhāricāndrā rimātargiyū| kasisaṁkula vūla sisvāhā| tadyathā|| iti mekū timera sahe sahe sahe saha sahe stuhe stuhe stuhe stuhe stuhe svāhā iti saddharmma paśunī kānāmadhāraṇī samāptā|| onamogāthā dvayāya|| oṁ padme mahāpadme ve pamodbhave sūkhāvatī ga。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 29 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：chantu svāhā|| iti śahā dvayaṁ kālagata śuddhayartha aṣṭobhtaraśa taṁjayyanyā paśuśubhavati|| āryya gāthā ghayanāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namo atītānāgata pratyaptannetye| samyakaṁ buddhayatyaḥ|| namo amitābhāya tathāgatā yārhate samyakaṁ buddhāya|| tadyathā|| oṁ mālī ci 2 amṛto bhave buddhavatī buddhabhāṣiṇi sarvva dharmmotkā prajvālani buddhi 2 mahābuddhi vitteramahāvitte vilavarbhti| vegavarbhti| gurudravyavarbhti indravajavegavarbhti| buddhāvalokite| mūnira namo| mahāmūni hūṁphaṭ buddha dharmma saṁgha vale sarvva yarrākṣa sākumbhā ṇuna pūṭana sarvva grahe vetāla nanāgāśca duṣṭa cibhtā navandha 2 kala 2 gṛnha 2 gata 2 māla 2 bhaṇjara yaha 2 paca 2 matha 2 sarvva buddhānāṁvalanā| nāśaya 2 chindara bhindara viṅāpaya 2 śatrūnāsarva rākṣā sodināṁ manuṣyā manuṣya valara vaṁdha 2 saṁkoca nikocita| sphoṭya garkṣāya 2 bhatrjū 2 hata 2 sa。

titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (30): rvvaṇatraṁ sarvvamantrātasarvvajogānu sarvvarākṣasā dināṁ rakṣa 2 māṁmamasarvva satvānāctra savvepidravo pasaṁgo pāyāsesyaḥ svāhā
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 30: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (30): rvvaṇatraṁ sarvvamantrātasarvvajogānu sarvvarākṣasā dināṁ rakṣa 2 māṁmamasarvva satvānāctra savvepidravo pasaṁgo pāyāsesyaḥ svāhā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §30
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (30)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 30 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：rvvaṇatraṁ sarvvamantrātasarvvajogānu sarvvarākṣasā dināṁ rakṣa 2 māṁmamasarvva satvānāctra savvepidravo pasaṁgo pāyāsesyaḥ svāhā|| āryyā amritā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| || oṁ namo ratnatrayāya|| oṁ namo buddhāya mahākāruṇikāya bharaṇikṛtahṛdayāya|| oṁ āḥ sugatavajatṛsyahoḥ svāhā|| āryya sugata nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namo bhagavate bheṣayavaiḍuryyaprabha rājāya tathāgatāyarhate samyakasaṁbuddhāya|| tadyathā oṁ bheṣaye 2 mahābhaiṣaṭta bhaiṣaṭate svāhā|| āryya bhaiṣayta rājanāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ maṇi padme hūṃ|| oṁ namo bhagavate āryyapara maguravai mahākāruṇikāya śākya manuṣye tathāgatā yārhate samyaksaṁbuddhāya|| tadyathā|| oṁ mūne 2 mahāmunaye svāhā|| āryya śākya muni nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namaḥ sapta saptīnāṁsamyaksaṁbuddhā koṭīnāṁ||。

titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 32: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (32): tato dhārayita vyāmānūṣpasyā rāja cūḍakaṇṭhecā likhikṛta dhārayetū sarvva michākaroti mtrīrupātra dhāraye yurājāvā atirakṣā karoti

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 32 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：tato dhārayita vyāmānūṣpasyā rāja cūḍakaṇṭhecā likhikṛta dhārayetū sarvva michākaroti mtrīrupātra dhāraye yurājāvā atirakṣā karoti|| parasainpadya yeti prāpta kā śrīlakṣīnā mutrcati pāpakāḥ|| idamavoca dbhagavānāttamanāsteca śakrādidevābhi kṣavo bodhisatvā mahāsatvā sāva sarvvāca tīparṣatsadevaḥ mānuṣā suragaruḍa gandharvvaśca loko bhagavato bhāṣita matyanandanniti| āryya dhvajā grakeyaranāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namaḥ śrī mahāsamvarāya|| pūrvvavataḍhatiṭhi śūnya tānantaraṁ hūṃ kāroṭbha vaṁ yogiṇī gaṇanākaṁ| bhairavaṁ kāli rātrīnatrca karttikā sūryyā gaupati ritāṇu vaṇna mahākāyaṁ kṛṣṇārddhaha ritārddha kaṁpaṣṭati jujāstasya saptadaśa trirocana jaṭā mekuṭa dharaṁvīraṁ viśvavajārddha candrakaṁ| mahādraṣṭrā kallāro śāṁsa vyāvasaḥ sadā|| nīlāpītāra。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第33品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (33): vaja hūṃ phaṭ
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (33): vaja hūṃ phaṭ
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 33: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (33): vaja hūṃ phaṭ
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §33
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (33)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 33 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：vaja hūṃ phaṭ|| oṁ vaja vārāhī mahādevī hūṁ phaṭ|| mūlamantraḥ|| iti mahāsatvara hṛdayaṁ samāptaṁ|| || oṁ namaḥ śrī cakamahāroṣanāya|| śrī matsyakta ravinvāya sarvvasattva pakāriṇi namo vighnoya saṁhāraṁ kāya triyaka muktayaṁkaraṇe deva khaṅāya sarvvanāpāya bhāvayene vāme prajñārga bhāṇyena tarjaṇi śaktapāśe| saptapātāra pārākṣamadhya vāmāya darśine śakravraṣkyaṇupāratvātnamaḥ savyerddha darśine bhūmautaktakṣaṇa tvātrya vineṣṭā vāmajānave| mahāprahāra saṁskārana savyapādāyate namaḥ|| magnaṁyena kṣacca rāva ramidaṁ mahāndhakāro dyaḥ|| prajñāpāya vibhāga bhāskara varai rvyaktaṁ samūdvīpitaṁ kṛtvā candra samādyamādya puruṣaḥ śrī vajasatvasvayaṁ|| soyaṁ tatsūkha sādhanāya jagativyakta prabhātiṣṭhātti|| tatomantragāthāḥ|| viśvāmbhoja dineśa maṇu lagataṁ hūṃ kāra vīyodbhavaṁ dṣṭābhiḥ para pīḍītādharamala dhārāṣṭra haṁsaparāḥ|| urdhyā māsā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 34 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：hā roṣaṇa samādhi hṛdaya samāptaṁ|| oṁ namaḥ śrī harukāya|| oṁ kroḍhapirgelakeśāya sahamratekṣasyadhara 2 jvāla 2 prajvāla 2 triśūla vyagrahate hara 2 prasara 2 dama 2 gṛntpāpaya 2 sarvva dūṣṭa satvānāṁ nāgānāgarājā nāṁ mūkhaṁ kīlaya 2 śulaṁnośa 2 piṁhanāśaya 2 aśmarāṇāśaya 2 evaṁ sarvva nāśānāṁ nāśaya 2 ekāhikaṁ dayāhikaṁ bhyāhikaṁ cāturthihikaṁ sarvvajvalaṁ sannipātajvalaṁ dūṣṭa jvalaṁ vātikaṁ pittikaṁ śreṣṭikaṁ sannipātikaṁ māsā-ī māsikaṁ sāmvatsarikaṁ evaṁ evaṁ sarva rogāna nāśaya 2 hūṃ śrī akṣotya vajarupamama sarvvasatvā nātrca śānti kūra 2 svāhā|| āryya śrī heru kaspaprasavaroganāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namo bhagavatyai āryyavajavārārṣke|| tadyathā|| oṁ namā bhagavati vajavārā hi āryya parājite trailokya mātre mahāvaidye sarvvabhūta yāvaha mahāvaja vajāmane ajite parājite vaśāṁkarane。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 35 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：gaḥ rājaruṣya vrailokya da mahamūdra rośanegrasa 2 hūṃ pha vīcāddhe te hūṃ hā 2 mahāyaśu mahāniyā gauritvaṁ ḍākiṇi lokānāṁ vandani saṁghaḥ pratyaya kālini hūṃ pha|| bhūta trāsani mahāvīra parama siddha vidyai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā|| valimantraḥ|| oṁ namo vajavārahī|| oṁ sarva ṣṭāna hūṃ phaṭ|| svāhā|| oṁ vajavārāhī āveśaya sarvvadūṣṭān svāhā|| upahṛdaya|| oṁ phū hrīṁ hāṃ|| hṛdayaḥ| oṁ a hriṁ hūṃ hā hūṃ|| ārya mahāmāyā vajavārāhī nāmadhāraṇī samāptā|| 31|| oṁ namaḥ śrīnairātmā mahādevyai|| oṁ namo bhagavatyai neṁ rairātmā dervye vajavirā śiniya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ|| oṁ namaḥ sarvva bhūta bhayāvahe mahāvaje hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ|| oṁ namo vajāsana akṣite aparājite vaśvaṁkara netratomani hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ| oṁ namaḥ jayāvijayā jambha nimbha vi mohāni。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (38): āryya ugratārā nāma dhāraṇī
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 38: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (38): āryya ugratārā nāma dhāraṇī
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 38 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：āryya ugratārā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| || oṁ namo ratna trayāya| namaḥ samanta buddhānāṁmahā jārgulī hṛdaya nāma tathāgatāyorhate samyūkkaṁ buddhāya|| tadyathā|| sarvva paramantra vandhaya surendra juvaṇavandhaya 2 mahācṭakṣi vandhaya 2 iha vāsināṁdhāraya 2 yenake nacit bhayādikaṁ chedya 2 bhedya 2 śiri 2 piri 2 hūṃ 3 phūṭ 3 namastu te svāhā|| iti āryya jārgulī hṛdaya nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| || oṁ namo daśakroṭāya|| yanmāntaka prajñāntaka padmāntaka ka-acalavīra tarkkirājanīla mahāvala uṣī ṣacakra sumbharājaḥ sarvva kroḍhetyaḥ pūrvva dakṣiṇa paścimottara agne vāyave iśāne naiṛte adha-ūrdhvamete daśadigmā lān| indra yamavarulaku vairādi agni vvayavo īśānādhipatiḥ naiṛtyā disaka lamālāḥ śrī guruvaja mājñā。

translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §39

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 39 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ka yavāk cittena|| tadyathā|| māraya 2 kāraya 2 garjjaya 2 s-hoṭhaya 2 dyāṭaya 2 sarvvaduṣṭānnā śaya 2 hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phuṭ phuṭ phuṭ phuṭ svāhā|| itri daśa kroṭha nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| 13|| oṁ namo ratna trayāya|| oṁ namaḥ samanta buddhānāṁmahā pratyagiroṣlīṣa cakra vakṣīrojāya tathāgatāyārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya|| tadyathā|| sarvva yantravandha 2 indra juvanavandha 2 cṭakṣa devavandha 2 dhāraya 2 iha vāsināṁyenakene cidbhayā dikaṁchindra 2 bhindra 2 ciri 2 girī 2 bhiri 2 hūṃ hūṃ phuṭ phuṭ svāhā|| āryya uṣī cakravartī nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| 14|| oṁ namo buddhāya|| lokā taṁnamamula vivikta jñāna vedane| yasatvaṁ jaga dvitārtha yakhinnaka ruma yāciraṁ|| skandhamātra vinirmūktona satvo stimite mataṁ| satvārthatrca parikhedaṁ agamasatrcaṁ mahāmune|| tepiskandhā sbhvayādhī。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第40品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (40): pratityasamutpādaḥ śunyetā mevate sadā
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (40): pratityasamutpādaḥ śunyetā mevate sadā
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 40: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (40): pratityasamutpādaḥ śunyetā mevate sadā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §40
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (40)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 40 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：pratityasamutpādaḥ śunyetā mevate sadā|| bhāvaḥ svatantronāstiti siṁhanādaṣṭa cātrare| sarvvasaṁkalpa hārāya śunyatā mṛtadeśanā|| yasyatasyā mapigrāhastvayā' sauvacasāhitaḥ| ninīśavasikāsinyā māyāvatpja-eya yodbhavāḥ|| sarvvadharmmastvayā nāthaniḥ svabhāvaḥ prakāśitā natvayātpatitaṁ kitaṁ kicintakitrcintira rodhitaṁ|| yathā pūrvvatathā paścāttatathā buddhavānasi| aryyaniṣecitā dharmma manāgasyahi bhāvanā| nimittānihi vijñānaṁ bhavatīha kathaṁcana| aninittāṁhi vijñānaṁ bhavatīha kathaṁcana| animitta manāgamya mokṣonāstitva muktavāna| atastvayā mahāyānatasmākalpena deśitaṁ|| yadavāvtaṁ mayaṁpuṇyaṁmutvā tvāṁmutibhājanaṁ| nimityevaṁdhanāyete bhuyānte nākhilaṁ jagat|| itiśrī lokātīta stavanāmastotraṁ samāptaṁ|| 15|| oṁ namaḥ śrī vajayogiśye|| evammayā śṛtamekasminsamayekṣa。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 41 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：sarvvaśāmtra viśāradaḥ|| kalyāṇa mitrasaṁtyevibodhicittā vibhuṣitaḥ|| sadāvirahito buddhairythatraya traupapadyate-iti|| āryyatārā bhaṭṭārikā yāḥ nāmāṣṭottaraśataṁ buddhabhāṣitaṁparisamāptaḥ|| oṁ namaḥ śrītārāyai||3|| vālākkā4lokatāṁmrapavarasuraśi caścāra cuḍāmaṇiśrī samyatsamparkka rāgānaticirara citrāraktakavyaktabhaktī|| bhakatyāpādautavāyya4karapuṭamukuto pabhugnottamārga stāriṇyā pachcaranya navamuti kusumasrāgbharabhyarvvayāmi|| dullaṁghe duḥkhavanhauvinipatita tanudurbhagaḥ kāndiśīkaḥ kiṁkiṁmuḍhaṁkaromītyasakṛ dapikṛtārambhaveyarthyākhinnaḥ|| śrutvā bhuyaḥ parebhyaḥ kṣatanya-ivavyombiśrandrākarvalakṣmī mālokāsānibaddha paragatigamanestvāṁ śrayaḥ pāpahantrīna|| sarvvasminsatvamārggenanutava karuṇā nirvviṇaṣaṁpravṛttāḥ tatmadhyatadragṛheṇagrahaṇamupatammādṛśasyāvyavaśyaṁ|。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第42品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (42): jñānārtha syāvidaḥ svīhṛdayala dhūta yā svacchatāṁvindatīca
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (42): jñānārtha syāvidaḥ svīhṛdayala dhūta yā svacchatāṁvindatīca
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 42: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (42): jñānārtha syāvidaḥ svīhṛdayala dhūta yā svacchatāṁvindatīca
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §42
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (42)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 42 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：jñānārtha syāvidaḥ svīhṛdayala dhūta yā svacchatāṁvindatīca|| kalyāṇānda siṁdhū prakaṭaśaśikaleśrī bharāṁde driṣṭaṣṭi pūṣṭijñānāya deśekurudhana karuṇaścaṁ sayaścātaṁ maktaḥ| ttvanstotrāṁbhaḥ pavitrīkṛtamanasimathiśreya saṁskāramekaṁ dṛṣṭuṁ yasmāda modhaṁjagati tavaguṇatramātraṁ prajānāṁ|| maṁsulatvaṅjugu ṇodhāvayavamaniyame yatra māptaṁ mayāyatpūṇyaṁ pūṇyādrevāṁchā phala madhura rasāsvāda bhābhakti bhogyam| lokastanāryya lokeśca svaraṇagarasva stikaṁsyāsmi ciṁkrāma krāyāyaṁ prayāyātsūgata sutamahītāstvā va ryāpāsyome|| inyāryyantarā bhaṭṭā rikāyāḥ śragdharāskāśraṁ samāptaṁ|| 90|| oṁ namaḥ śrī āryya ugra tārā yo ekajaṭāyai|| namaḥ śrāvakapraścaka yūśca bodhisatva krorarajāyūśca dharmmasaṁghasyaḥ| namo bhagavate parama gurave mahākāruṇi kāyaśākka mūnaye tathāgato yorhame sampakkaṁ būddhāya|| evaṁ。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第43品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (43): nyasavacanaṁyathā
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (43): nyasavacanaṁyathā
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 43: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (43): nyasavacanaṁyathā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §43
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (43)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 43 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：nyasavacanaṁyathā|| yāntrīdhārayake vidyāprasūyaṅuṇī sukhaṁ| apūtrī labhatepūtraṁvyādhi mūkto sukhāśiṇī|| dhanadhānyaiṁ valaiḥ pūṇyāmo nanīyā priyaṁvadā| sūsva prāsavya karī vajiṇakṣataṁ samāpnayātū|| oṁ āḥ rima ha haḥ|| idamavoca dbhavagavānsāya padmamālagiriyarṣa tsadeva mānūṣā suraga ruḍa gandharvva ścalākobhagavato bhāṣita matyanandanniti|| āryyā eka jaṭā nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namaḥ śrīdharmma dhātave|| natvā rktavandhū jūgade kavandhū svayaṁ tubhadrārakamādidevaṁ| jarā-ūjā mṛtyūharai kadakṣaṁkṣyetadddeśamahaṁ samastaṁ|| nepālejagati khyāte gośṛ gonāma parvdataḥ bhedosticaja getassa nāstrācajagabhedakaḥ|| yūgyesatyapanāgirimtetā thāṁvaja kūṭakaḥ| gośṛṅovāpare khyātāḥ kaligopūcha parvataḥ|| gartekālabhaviṣya cavarnta māne pravartate|| itiddeśavāśī。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第45品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (45): ndhāpinā samāgata
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (45): ndhāpinā samāgata
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 45: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (45): ndhāpinā samāgata
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §45
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (45)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 45 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ndhāpinā samāgata || cūḍedeviārājāvijñāpitaṁ pūṇya puṣpadūpanaividyādisarvopakaraṇa sajjakṛtavān || tadāsūnakṣatra śrebhādrapadakṛṣṇatṛtīyādivase sarvvaṁvratamārādhayā bhītyuktvā vrate karmācarit || tadāśrīvasudhārā svayamāgatā sarvasattvasvarggamokṣa parāyanaṁdvati || cūḍadevyāvacanaṁ śṛtvā rājapinsarvvajanā sambhāṣyavrata bandhanaṁkaroti || tasminjaṇe muhūrttamātreṇa śrivasudhārāsvathamāgatyavansakiṁvilaṁbita mitiyathāmayādeśitathā kariṣyadhvaṁ || tatorādiśrī vasūdhārāṁ dṛṣṭava rājā utphūlla hṛdayaṁbhūtvāsasaṁtramenaśrī vasūdhārāyopādakamalaṁśirasāsaṁpṛktā uktavāna || yathādevī prasanno bhūtvā tathākariṣyati vratasaṁpūrṇakṛtvā rājāprabhṛti sarvvasatvāstu ṣitatuvanaṁnīyate || rājapūtrameṁkaṁjauca rājaṁsaṁ pūrṇṇa svāpayitvā dharmmadeśanāryaṁtejanauvanena sarvvamāryamaṇḍale prakāśayitvā sūkhenatiṣṭhati || itiśrī vasudhārāvratapūrvvamartyamaṇḍalāgata kathā samāptaṁ ||。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.tangNoteZh: ndhāpinā samāgata || cūḍedeviārājāvijñāpitaṁ pūṇya puṣpadūpanaividyādisarvopakaraṇa sajjakṛtavān || tadāsūnakṣatra śrebhādrapadakṛṣṇatṛtīyādivase sarvvaṁvratamārādhayā bhītyuktvā vrate karmācarit || tadāśrīvasudhārā svayamāgatā sarvasattvasvarggamokṣa parāyanaṁdvati || cūḍadevyāvacanaṁ śṛtvā rājapinsarvvajanā sambhāṣyavrata bandhanaṁkaroti || tasminjaṇe muhūrttamātreṇa śrivasudhārāsvathamāgatyavansakiṁvilaṁbita mitiyathāmayādeśitathā kariṣyadhvaṁ || tatorādiśrī vasūdhārāṁ dṛṣṭava rājā utphūlla hṛdayaṁbhūtvāsasaṁtramenaśrī vasūdhārāyopādakamalaṁśirasāsaṁpṛktā uktavāna || yathādevī prasanno bhūtvā tathākariṣyati vratasaṁpūrṇakṛtvā rājāprabhṛti sarvvasatvāstu ṣitatuvanaṁnīyate || rājapūtrameṁkaṁjauca rājaṁsaṁ pūrṇṇa svāpayitvā dharmmadeśanāryaṁtejanauvanena sarvvamāryamaṇḍale prakāśayitvā sūkhenatiṣṭhati || itiśrī vasudhārāvratapūrvvamartyamaṇḍalāgata kathā samāptaṁ ||

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第46品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (46): vasudārāyā nāmoṣśettaraśataṁ buddhabhāṣitaṁ

titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 46: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (46): vasudārāyā nāmoṣśettaraśataṁ buddhabhāṣitaṁ
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §46

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 46 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：bhāyapriyadarśiṇī | sārthavāhakṛpādṛṣṭi sarvathāgatātmakī | caturdānaṁ pradāsyāmi caturvrantra vihāriṇī || caturādya satyadeva ṛddhisiddhīpradāyinī | namaste tu mahādevī sarvasatvārthadāyinī | namostute divyarupī ca vasudhāre namostute || aṣṭhotta (bhū) raśataṁ nāma trikālaṁ yaḥ paṭhadimaṁ || prāpnoti niyataṁ siddhīmīpsitaṁ sunoharaṁ || pīdjñānāt kṛtaṁ pāpaṁ ānaṁtaryyudāruṇāṁ || tatsarvaṁ kṣepayiṣyanti smaraṇāt nāma bhadrakaṁ || atharā śīlasaṁpannaḥ sajāti smaraṇo bhavet || priyañcodaya vākyurapavān priyadarśaṇaḥ || kṣātriyaviprakuloṣu ādyamupajāyate | ante bhūmīśaraṁ prāpya saṁprayāt sukhovatāṁ || 0 || iti śrīvasudārāyā nāmoṣśettaraśataṁ buddhabhāṣitaṁ samāptam || 83 || om namo bhagavatyai āryaśrīvajavidārityai || namo ratnatrayo(yā) yā || evaṁ mayā śrutamekasmin samaye bhagavān vajaṣu viharati sma || sarvaśarīraṁ vajamayamadhiṣṭhāya vajrakoṭa...。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第47品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (47): prasanna citta sūmanoḥ śucivastrairalaṁkṛtaḥ
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (47): prasanna citta sūmanoḥ śucivastrairalaṁkṛtaḥ
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 47: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (47): prasanna citta sūmanoḥ śucivastrairalaṁkṛtaḥ
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §47
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (47)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 47 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：prasanna citta sūmanoḥ śucivastrairalaṁkṛtaḥ || teca sarvva priduṣṭātmā upasargga sudāraḥ nanejānsidapraśānyente samastāḥ sarvvamonphatāṁā yuścavardvate puṇyaṁ sarvvapāpaurvimocitaṭha || maṇi sarṣapadūrvābhiḥ ratnākṣala saṁvandarneḥ | vajūbhāchīna puṣpaiśca jalabhā yūrjjakāñcanaṁ || ghaṭaṁturajataṁ vāpiśu vivestuṇavāsitaṁ || eka viṁśativā raṁvāvālamaṣṭhāttaraśataṁ || jayaṃdvaja vidāraṇaṁ mantraṁsnādhāyatpārthivaḥ sadā || evaṁpaśyahi dinātne satata sapadayateśubhaṁ || || ita mavocad bhagavāna vajapāṇirbhāṣita matyāntunniti || iti āryyaśrīvajacidāriṇī hṛdaya mūlamaṁtra dhāraṇī samāpta || 84 || om namo bhagavatyai āryyagavaṇāti hṛdayāyai || sumukhaścai vadantaśya kapirogaja karṇukaṁ likhādaṁsalaścaṇikato ghna rājovināyakaḥ || dhamake karṇaṇādhikṣā bhāracandro gajānana śrī vakratuṇḍaḥ kla varṇṇā helambaskaṁndapūrvva。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (48): ġtaḥ śāntidaḥ śuddhaḥ saṁkaraḥ priyaṁ bāṁdhavaḥ aṣṭamutinnidhīśca jñāna vakṣastapāmayaḥ
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 48: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (48): ġtaḥ śāntidaḥ śuddhaḥ saṁkaraḥ priyaṁ bāṁdhavaḥ aṣṭamutinnidhīśca jñāna vakṣastapāmayaḥ
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §48
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (48)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 48 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ġtaḥ śāntidaḥ śuddhaḥ saṁkaraḥ priyaṁ bāṁdhavaḥ aṣṭamutinnidhīśca jñāna vakṣastapāmayaḥ || aṣṭhādhyāraṁ ṣatrodyaraḥ sarvvaktaḥ śikhīsakaḥ dhudharo bhudharādhī śopatiḥ bhupatiḥ bhudharātmajaḥ || kaṁkāladhārī muṇṇīca nāgayajña pavītavāna | jamtha nāsohe nastaṁbhimāraṇaḥ kṣomavasatthatā || śuddhanī tmābtrahana prakhyādetya muṇuvibhuṣitaḥ | valitukavalitugnotho vālocāla parākramāḥ | sarvvopatta | bhūta niṣavitaḥ kākinacārasyakasyaciṁdevatāraṁ prayatchati || avatāraṁ pratilapyati nacosya bodhicittantarā yā bhaviṣyati || jātau jātau jātismarobhaviṣyati || itamo c gavonātta manāsteca bhikṣavāstaca bādhisatvā mahāsatvāsocana sarvva 1 vitīparṣartīsadeva mānuṣā sura garuḍa kinnara mahāra gagandhardhaśca lokābhagavate bhāṣita sammayanandanviti || aryya gaṇapati hṛdayānāmadhyāraṇī parisamāptaḥ || om namo bhagavatye āryyāṁvaṣṣa vinayāṁye || evam。

translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 49 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：vitamatyanandanniti || āryyaṣnīvijayamāntāmadhāraṇī parisamāptāṁ || om namo bhagavatyai āryyapūrṣṇa suvatī tārārai || om namo amitābhāya tathāgatāyārhatesamyakkaṁ būddhāya || namo dharmmāyā namomahāsyāthamaprāpataya || vāmanetyīnemesthāmitvāṁnasasyāmivā mane || bhagavatipiśācipūrṇṇa savaripāśa paraśudhāriyā niphakānidabhayānpūtyakṣyante || yānimāni cinmahāmāyāryakecidūpadravāḥ sabūddhā vā tyadyante || sarvāṇitāni vālatai nravātyadayante || tena pāṇtitastadane nastyanasatye vacanenaṁ || jajajaja || etiḥ yantritādhiṣṭhitairmantra padairmasarvvasatvāścarakṣāṁkuru | parimrarhakurūśāntiṁsvastyayarnayaṇu parihārraśamtra parihāraṁviṣadū ṣaṇaṁkuru | agniparihāraṁkuru | udakaparihāraṁ || kāravārddacchedanaṁkurūśīmāvandhakuru || tadayathā || om amṛte amṛtādrave | amṛtasaṁbhave avīṁste aśvaste gemāgara 2 māsara 2 śama。

titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (50): praśame sarvvā kāla mṛtyanupaśama sarvvanakṣatra grehadoṣānupaśama sarvva drīṣṭraṇaśvo paśama bhagavati śiciparṇṇasavari
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 50: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (50): praśame sarvvā kāla mṛtyanupaśama sarvvanakṣatra grehadoṣānupaśama sarvva drīṣṭraṇaśvo paśama bhagavati śiciparṇṇasavari
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §50
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (50)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 50 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：praśame sarvvā kāla mṛtyanupaśama sarvvanakṣatra grehadoṣānupaśama sarvva drīṣṭraṇaśvo paśama bhagavati śiciparṇṇasavari || tunna 2 vitunna 2 tuna 2 bhūmule svāhā || om piśāci parṇṇaśavari hrīṁ hūṃ phaṭa piśāci svāhā || āryyaparṇṇaśavarī mahāmārī praśamanīnāmadhāraṇī samāpta || 87 || om namo bhagavatye āryya mārīcyai || evaṁ mayā śrutame kasminsamaye bhagavāna śrāvassyāṁ viharatisma || jetavane'nāthapiṇḍadasthārāme mahātā bhikṣu saṁghena sārdhva mardhva trayodaśa mibhikṣaśataiḥ saṁpakṣalaiśca boddhisatvermahāsatveḥ || tatrakhalu bhagavāna bhikṣa nāmantrayatesma || asmibhikṣa vomārīcīnāma devatā sārsyyācandramasoḥ puratongachati ya || sānadṛśātenagaghate | navadhyatena || namudhyatena || namukhyate | namudhtate || nadaṇḍāte namudyate。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第51品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (51): padravetyaḥ svahā
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (51): padravetyaḥ svahā
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 51: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (51): padravetyaḥ svahā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §51
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (51)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 51 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：padravetyaḥ svahā || om namo ratnatrayāya || om bhagavatye āryya mārīcī namaḥ | om vanalavarttarivadari 2 carārivarāha mukhi sarvvadūṣṭānāṁ cakṣamukhavaṇdhare svāhā || āryya mārīcī nāmadhāraṇīpari samāpta || 88 || om namo bhagavatye āryya grahamātṛtakāyai || evammayāśrutame kasminsamaye bhagavāna ḍakavatyī mahānagaryyāṁ aneka devanāga yakṣa gandarvā asūra garuḍa kinnara mahāragā ditya somāṅgarādi būdhavṛhaspati śukra śaniścarādi rokṣaketu bhiraṣṭhā viṁśati nakṣarādi bhistuyamā nāma mahāvaja samayāla ṅkāravyūhādhiṣṭhāno dhiṣṭhite siṁhāsane viharatisma || aneka bodhisatva śatasahaśraisārdhvaṁ || tadyathā || vaja pāṇinācanāma bodhisatvena satve || vajamatināya nāma bodhisatvaśrenamahāsatvena || vaja vandeṇaca nāma bodhisatvena mahāsatvena || vaja vegenaca nāma bodhisatvena mahāsatvena || vaja senenaca nāma bo。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第52品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (52): vanniti praṇabhyānta hiṁtobhavanniti
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (52): vanniti praṇabhyānta hiṁtobhavanniti
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 52: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (52): vanniti praṇabhyānta hiṁtobhavanniti
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §52
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (52)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 52 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：vanniti praṇabhyānta hiṁtobhavanniti || idamavocadbhagavānātta manāstecaphiphavaḥ sācasarvāvatī parṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa kinnara mahāragā bhagavato bhāṣita satya nandanniti || āryyagṛhamātṛkānāma dhāraṇī samāpta || om namoḥ rāhave || evaṁmayā śṛtamekasminsamayebhagavān aḍakavanyāṁ mahānagaryyā aneka devanāga yakṣa gandharvā sura garuḍa kinnara mahāragā pasmārāditya somāgāra budha bṛhaspati śukra śaniścarā rāhu ketubhiraṣṭāviṁśati bhiśca nakṣatrādi bhistuna māna mahāvajra samayā laṁkādhiṣṭānā dhiṣṭitaṁ siṁhāsane viharatisma || aneka bodhisatvaśata sahastreḥ sārdhva || ramaitreya bodhisatvena mahā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第53品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (53): ntibhavakisma
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (53): ntibhavakisma
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 53: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (53): ntibhavakisma
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §53
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (53)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 53 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ntibhavakisma || satvānāṁ viharayantisma || upadravāntisma || keṣāñcidravyapaharāntisma || kaṁpāñcinprāṇama paharantisma || evasarvvasatvānā mupadraṁṇavāhyantisma || tadadaśeyanuṇa bhagavana dharmma paryyāyacesarvasatvānāṁ raktābhavaṁtisma || om rāhavaya ravi śaśihasrāya khaṅagapheṭakāya urdhva pityalakeśāyaddaṣṭākkatā vikṛtānanāya sarvva bhayarananaya || pūrvarogasāntāyanamo namaḥ rādbhūdevatāya || śāṁntibhavantume sarvva dāvatajā pitajā vāgāśoṣmājā sannipātañcana saṁnitā amṛtapiyāya rāhave sarva vighna prasāntayetu || idamavāhacaha gavantaca vājapāṇyāda yamatya nandanniti || āryyānāhavyagraha śānti upadrava nāma dhāraṇī pari samāptaḥ || om namaḥ śrī āryyakatavai || evammacā śṛtamekasminsamaye aṅkacatyāṁ deva śanāga yakṣa gandharvvāsura guraḍa kinnara mahoragā apasmārāditya somāṅgāla。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (54)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 54 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：māyaprasādhayasarvadṛṣṭānaśodhaya sarvaṣāṁcaṇuracaṇḍinī 2 turu 2 sūma 2 mūñca 2 havā hvayabhecābhavya ugrā ugra gape bhagavati sarvasatvānāñca manārathaṁ paripūraya sarva tathāgata samavedhiṣṭhite samaye svāhā || idamavocadbhagavānāta mahāvaja pāṇīmatyarandanniti || āryyaketugrahaśāṁtapaṇāmadhāraṇī pari samāpta || om nako viprāntakāya || viprāṁtakamahāvīra trailovighnarhatāra cilamipi gaurddhakeśasūmerucaudrāgraivapañcakapāla molitāṁnī 2 varṇṇa śusobhitaṁ gajīgagipare sthaṁpradhtālevriṇirocarnalalāvikṣāśurekṣaṇaṁ || nāgakūṇula bhūṣitaṁnānoratna manīṣālā gṛvyadīvya praktoritaṁ sarvarakṣanasaṁpūktaṁ || ṣāṭabhūjadharaṁ nāyaṁda hina karttidaṁvara mahāmādājāgaraṁ vāmakhatvāgaṁprotraṁcarva jamaṅgara yāśadharaṁ | hastimaṣūdharaṁpāda āriḍādhapādayūgaṁhasticarmāśusobhāva, vyāghracarmākāṭhiddardha || hārārdva hālaropūraṁnāgacarmmaśusobhitaṁ dakṣiṇadigaṣṭārtha sarvvasatvaḍa dhālaraṁgītācāryya jabhāsaktaṁdūḥkhanā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

mūlamupacayaṁ gacchatyapacayaṁ vā| nāso bhagavan prajñāpāramitāṁ bhāvayati|| yasya kasya cidharmma syopacayo vā

translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §55
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (55)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 55 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：saṁnamaskataṁ || advisidviprasādañcarabhairavāṇāṁnamomṛtevedaśunyaddarbhāśaraṁpoṣakṛṣṇaśumaṁñjaṁladaśakroḍhagaṇemūlakroḍarājaṁ namāmyahaṁ || itidaśakroḍadhāraṇī samāptaṁ || om namo bhagavatyai āryyāmahāsāhasrapramardaṇyai || smādamabhedaṁ || siddhasūmidṛsakhearearaścavalemahāvane jāhajaṭilaakhanemakhane laṭekharaṅgaharipiṁgale timigile timiṅgalinirmagale svāhā || sidhontumamamantu padāḥ sarva satvā nāñcaveśracapasyamahārojasyanānnāvalenaiśvaryyādhipate naca svāhā || syādbhedaṁ || akheñnakhevinakhevandhovarāśecapalevūkhevakhane aścinaṁvalebhage bhagandare vaśevaśavarttiṇisvāhā || mūcyantu mamasarvvasatvānāñca sarvagrahetyaḥ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya mahārājasyanāmnābalenaiścaryyādhipate na ca svāhā || syāddyabhedaṁ || kha kha kha me khalane khalā me khalali khe khaṭakhe khaṭine kharalikhara khi karāne karaṭa kālakāminividhali | vidhiyo vidheyā śayano samavato śamiśa。

deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (56)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 56 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：śimesvasti 2 śānti 2 samāgrimama saparivārasthañcamiṣaṁ samsṛṣṭayatha hārenirāmiṣāṁyenadagdha yathā sūtraṁ satyaṁkūrvantu tādṛśaṁsthādathedaṁ kalame kalale khalame agnisaṁkrāmanisvāhā || vipaśvibūddhaśaraṇaṁ upaiti śikhiṅca būddha sūgatañca viśvabhuṁ krakrachandabūddha kanakamūniñca kāśyapaṁ viśaradaśākya mūniñca gautama || etāsaptanarottamānāṁ pūṣpaiśvagandhaiścaśarīrapūjāṁ | kāyenateṣā menasāca bhontu prasannacitta śaraṇacaraṇamūpaiti || eteṣubuddheṣūmaharddhikeṣū || yādevatāsanti abhiprasannaḥ | tādevatā attamano udagrārakṣantume adyapradā pramattāḥ || svastyastu mamasarvva satvānāñca svāhā || ityāryya mahāsāhasrapramadardanī nāmamahāyāna sūtraṁ samāptah || om namo bhagavātyai āryya mahāmāyūryya vidyā rājajñe || namaḥ samyakasaṁbūddhabhyaḥ || samyaksabūddha nānpravarapṛthū kṛpāyā jagūḥ saptasaṁkhyānkrūthākrūro ragendrānkṣatavi |。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第57品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (57): dveṣaścamohaśca etehno ketrayorviṣāḥ
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (57): dveṣaścamohaśca etehno ketrayorviṣāḥ
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 57: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (57): dveṣaścamohaśca etehno ketrayorviṣāḥ
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §57
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (57)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 57 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：dveṣaścamohaśca etehno ketrayorviṣāḥ || nirvviṣā bhagavāna dharmmā dharma satyahataṁ viṣaṁ || rāgadveṣaśca mohaśca eteloketra yorviṣāḥ | nirvviṣo bhagavānsaṁghasatyahataviṣaṁ || yadvalaṁ buddhānāṁ arhtāṁce vayadyasaḥ | tathāgataspatejena mamasarvva satvatrya kṛtsvastya yanaṁmayā || || āryyamahāmāyūrī vidyārārājñī avinaṣṭāyakṣa prasutvānpratiladdhā samāptāḥ || 3 || ḍeṁnamo bhagavatyai āryya mahāśītavatyai || tadyathā || ajgāvajgāka sijgā bhargāvarajgā saṁsāraṁtajgā bhageṣusurā ekataraṁgā asura | virāta ravīrā- tara 2 vīrākara vīrākara 2 vīrāindrā indra kisarā haṁsā haṁsakisarāpicimālā | mahākivvā | viheṭhikā | kālucchikā | agodarājayā likā | velā elācintāli | cili 2 hili 2 | sumuti va sumati | ralunadre | culū 2 nate 2 nadre | culunadi | kināḍi | hārīṭavirka 2 kāriṭarki。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §58
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (58)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 58 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ni | sādhani | vidhani viśodhani | saṁśodhani | saṁkhiraṇi | saṁkiraṇi | saṁcchidani | sādhūtaramāne | taramāne | hanū 2 bandhūmati | hiri 2 khiri 2 khanali | hurū 2 khurū 2 namostu buddhānāṁ bhagavatāṁ svahā || asyā khalu punarāhūlamahāśītavatī vidyāyāṁ | daśottara yadaśatāyām sutregranchiṁ baddhāhastena dhāryya māryā mānāyāṁ kaṇḍena dhāryyamānāyāṁ samantādyo | janaśatasya rakṣākṛto bhavati || īyaṁ khalu yunaḥ mahāśītayatī vidyāyāṁ eka navatyā śaṅ | nadī bālikā samairbbuddhai bhagavat bhirbhāṣitābhāṣiṣyante || āryya mahāśītavatīnāma mahāvidyārājñī parisamāptā || 4 || om namo bhagavatyai āryyamahāpratisarayai || lokārtha siddhi paramaṁbahū ratnavittā dharmmārthakāmamaśa maṁśravanāyadhīrāḥ | āyāṇḍa yakṣāsūradaityasaṁdyāḥ | pūjāvidhānaniratāgaruḍānendrāḥ | āryyāmimāṁ pratisarāṁsmṛtimā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第59品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (59): amṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (59): amṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 59: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (59): amṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §59
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (59)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 59 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：amṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā || om bhava 2 saṁbhara 2 indriyavalaviśodhane hūṃ hūṃ ru ru ca ce svahā | om maṇidharivajrīṇi mahāpratisare hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svahā || upahṛdaya vidyā || ārya mahāpratisarāyāḥ prathamaḥ kalpa samāptaḥ || 0 || atra mantrapadāsiddhāḥ samyakkaṁ buddhenabhāṣitāḥ || namo buddhāya | namo dhammāya | namaḥ saṁghāya || namo bhagavate śākya munaye mahākāruṇi | kāyatathāgatāyārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya || namaḥ samantebhyaḥ samyakkaṁ buddhebhyo bhāvanaināṁ namaskṛtya buddha śāranevaddhaye || alamidānīṁ pravakṣāmi sarva satvānūkampajā || īmāṁ vidyāṁmahātejāṁ mahābalaparākramāṁ || yasyāṁ bhāṣita mātrāyāṁmūnināvajama yāśane || mārāśca mārakāyā racagrahāḥ sa。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第60品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (60): ha śānti svāhā
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (60): ha śānti svāhā
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 60: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (60): ha śānti svāhā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §60
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (60)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 60 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ha śānti svāhā || om bhūḥ om bhūri bhūri rivaja vati sarvva tathāgata hṛdaya yuriṇi āyuḥ saṁdhāriṇi vala vala vatija yavidye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phū ṭ svāhā || om maṇidharivajīṇi mahāprasare hūṃ hūṃ pha ṭ pha ṭ svāhā || namaḥ sarvva tathāgatetyāye 2 pitiṣṭhaṁtidaśa sudikṣa || om maṇi vaje hṛdaya vajemārasainya vidāriṇihana 2 sarvva śatrun rakṣa 2 mamaśarīraṁ sarva savvānāñca 2 vaje 2 vaja garvbha 2 || trāsatya 2 sadharmāra bhavanāni hūṃ hūṃ pha ṭ pha ṭ pha sambhara sambhara svāhā || buddha sarvva tathāgata kalyādhiṣṭhite sarvva karmmā ca raṇānyapanaya svāhā || āryya mahāpratisarāyāḥ mahāvidyārājñāḥ rakṣā vidhāna kalpaḥ samāptaḥ || 95 || om namo bhagavatyai āryya mahāmantrā ||。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第65品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (65): sarasvataṁsarthipibe sma ptābhimantritaṁ
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (65): sarasvataṁsarthipibe sma ptābhimantritaṁ
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 65: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (65): sarasvataṁsarthipibe sma ptābhimantritaṁ
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §65
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (65)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 65 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：sarasvataṁsarthipibe sma ptābhimantritaṁ || caturguṇa ajākṣīre ghṛtamasyaṁ vipācayet || jaiṣa'dhopari kāmātraṁsanaimṛhyabhivāsūdhīḥ | māṣamātraprabhūṁ jītavarṇīṁ prāpnośvanastaraṁ || ṣanmāsaprayogena sākṣādvāgīśvaro bhavet || rutakokila nirghāṣaḥ jāyate bhadhūra svarāḥ | saṁśayāne hūkartyavyāsūcintā bhavaḥ śaktayaḥ || itiśrī sarasvatī nāmadhāraṇī pari samāptaḥ || 100 || om namaḥ ścarmmapūṇulīkāyai || om vajaścaṇṭa āḥ om raṇa'paraṇa' saṁpraraṇa' sarvva buddha pracāriṇī prajñāpāramitā nādasvabhāvaḥ sattoṣaṇa karāya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || saddharma ṭhārūndhremaṁdha ṇṭhovādana sampanno manuṇadayānyū。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 66 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ṣpadhūpadīpa gandha yathā vidhinā sarvva dayāt || om āḥ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || iti saddharmma pāṭhanāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 101 om namaḥ śrī vajatārāyai || om tāre sarva vighnaha sarvva bhaya śānti kare pratibhā samakṛte sarvva dūṣṭā nastaythaya'jayastūya' jastū' mohya' hūṃ ' phaṭ ' sarvva dūṣṭa pradūṣṭā nstastūnīśca hūṃ phaṭ || itiśrī vajastārānāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 102 || namo ratna trayāya || om amoghapāśa mahādāna pāramitā paripūraye hūṃ om dala' vidala' vividha vicitra sarvasatvo pabhoga sarvva tathāgata mahādāna pūjāmegha pravaḻīya' gāraye mahāpadma pāṇi hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || iti dānapāramitā nāmadhāraṇī samā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第68品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (68): karuṇāḥ sarvasatva amanātha hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (68): karuṇāḥ sarvasatva amanātha hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 68: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (68): karuṇāḥ sarvasatva amanātha hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §68
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (68)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 68 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：karuṇāḥ sarvasatva amanātha hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || itivīryya pāramitā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 106 || om namo dhyāna paramitā yai | om sarvatathāgata amogha mahākaṇika dhyāna pāra mitā samādhi sarvasatva vimokṣa aprakamyakaḥ cura 2 dhurū 2 hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā || ti dhyāna pāramitā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 107 || om namo prajñā pāramitāyai || om namo amāghayā śamamahāprajñā pāyaphsaraṇa buddhi mahābuddhi parasara 2 mahāprasara 2 samanta buddhi avalokite cajña ṣo prajñāpāyadarppadaraṇī mahāprajñā yabhadhāraṇī tukṣa 2 mahānuna hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā || itiprajñāpāramitā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 108 || om namo bhagava。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第69品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (69): bhyaiṣadhāra mitāyai
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (69): bhyaiṣadhāra mitāyai
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 69: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (69): bhyaiṣadhāra mitāyai
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §69
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (69)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 69 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：bhyaiṣadhāra mitāyai || om namo dharmmakāya saṁbhoga kāya nirmmāṇakāya || tadyathā || om dānapāramitā śīlapāramitā kṣāntipāramitā viryyapāramitā dhyānapāramitā prajñāpāramitā sarvvadharmmaśūnyatāca bodhi 2 mahābodhaya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || itiṣadadhāra mitā nāma hṛdayadhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 102 || om namoḥ saptasaptīnāṁtathā gatānāṁ samyakkaṁ buddha koṭī nāṁ || tathayā || om cule cule cunde svāhā || iti cunde bhagavanya dhāraṇī pratidinayaḥ śviddhāra ye vdācayenkikhāpayata || aṣṭotbhara vāraṁjayetaṁ || tasyasarvva pāpaṁrikṣayaṁ yānticatu rvarga phalaṁprāpyateti || āryyacundā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 110 ||。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第70品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (70): na dhānya hiraṇya suvarṇṇu bhojanaṁca prāpayiṣyanti
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (70): na dhānya hiraṇya suvarṇṇu bhojanaṁca prāpayiṣyanti
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 70: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (70): na dhānya hiraṇya suvarṇṇu bhojanaṁca prāpayiṣyanti
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §70
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (70)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 70 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：na dhānya hiraṇya suvarṇṇu bhojanaṁca prāpayiṣyanti || om namo ratnatrayāya || namo mānibhadrāya mahāyakṣasenā pataye saṁpraskitaṁ || om hili 2 māṇibhadrakili 2 māṇibhadra.śici 2 māṇibhadrakurū 2 māṇibhadra surū 2 māṇibhadra. sarvvasīparipuraya || tadyathā || suratkai suratkī sumenpe suratthe sayiṣpe hi limiliki like lika likā li pūrṇṇu dravatī tiri 2 svāhā || āryyajanha harandrasya nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 111 || om namaḥ śri ugratārāyaiḥ || prakaṭa vikaṭa draṁṣṭayā ghaula rupādra hā sānariśrara kṛta mālāmaighava rṇṇutikharvva | triguṇāja dhātrīkha ṅaga vinyastaka karakalita kapāla pātuvaḥ ugratāroḥ || dhyāmurttī nama stotraḥ dyārarupo。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。
